article_content: Tech giant Google is reportedly planning to enter the U.S. auto insurance market. According to analyst Ellen Carney, an entity called Google Compare Auto Insurance Services is not licensed to sell insurance in 26 states. However, it is authorized to sell policies in one state for six insurers. Further evidence suggests a Google executive has been authorized to sell insurance using Google Compare. The Wall Street Journal reports that Google might collaborate with CoverHound, an auto-insurance comparison site based in San Francisco.  It is speculated that Google intends to disrupt the industry by bypassing intermediaries, similar to their impact on the shopping and travel sectors. In response to these reports, a Google spokeswoman stated, 'We can't comment on speculation, but we appreciate your coverage.' Greg Isaacs, president of Insurance Solutions at CoverHound, confirmed that Meredith Stechbart of Google is now endorsed on their insurance license. He acknowledged the speculation about disrupting middlemen, but added, 'We haven't been acquired' and declined further comment on potential shared plans. Google may face resistance as insurance companies might be unwilling to share data with a potential competitor. Similarly, some retailers have declined to add a 'buy' button for products to be purchased directly from Google pages. The Journal notes that as smartphone users are increasingly directed to various company apps for purchases, Google is compelled to enhance its search capabilities.
translated_content: Gergasi teknologi Google dilaporkan merancang untuk memasuki pasaran insurans kereta A.S. Menurut penganalisis Ellen Carney, entiti bernama Google Compare Auto Insurance Services tidak dilesenkan untuk menjual insurans di 26 negeri. Walau bagaimanapun, ia dibenarkan untuk menjual polisi di satu negeri bagi enam syarikat insurans. Bukti lanjut menunjukkan seorang eksekutif Google telah diberi kuasa untuk menjual insurans menggunakan Google Compare. The Wall Street Journal melaporkan bahawa Google mungkin bekerjasama dengan CoverHound, sebuah laman web perbandingan insurans kereta yang berpangkalan di San Francisco.  Spekulasi menyatakan bahawa Google berhasrat untuk mengganggu industri dengan memintas orang tengah, serupa dengan impak mereka dalam sektor perniagaan membeli-belah dan pelancongan. Sebagai respons kepada laporan ini, seorang jurucakap Google menyatakan, 'Kami tidak dapat mengulas mengenai spekulasi, tetapi kami menghargai liputan anda.' Greg Isaacs, presiden Insurance Solutions di CoverHound, mengesahkan bahawa Meredith Stechbart dari Google kini disahkan pada lesen insurans mereka. Beliau mengakui spekulasi mengenai gangguan orang tengah, tetapi menambah, 'Kami belum diambil alih' dan enggan mengulas lanjut mengenai potensi rancangan bersama. Google mungkin menghadapi tentangan kerana syarikat insurans mungkin keberatan untuk berkongsi data dengan pesaing yang berpotensi. Begitu juga, sesetengah peruncit telah menolak untuk menambah butang 'beli' untuk produk yang boleh dibeli terus dari halaman Google. The Journal menyatakan bahawa memandangkan pengguna telefon pintar semakin beralih kepada aplikasi syarikat yang berbeza untuk pembelian, Google terpaksa meningkatkan keupayaan carian mereka.

article_content: A content creator who documents his life in a Tesla decided to embark on a journey to Alaska, specifically driving through a very isolated 320-mile section of the Alcan Highway.  While some electric vehicle owners have reported negative experiences on long journeys, Sandro van Kuijck, having lived in his Tesla for a year and driven it across 49 US states, told Business Insider that he doesn't often worry about running out of charge.  He stated his aim was to test his Model X in one of America's most remote regions to prove EVs are versatile enough for any destination. Van Kuijck admitted that even with his EV travel expertise, the Alaskan trip presented some problems. During his nine-day roundtrip from Oregon to Alaska and back, he had to carefully monitor his Model X's battery range, especially through a 320-mile area of the Alcan Highway where he lost phone signal and couldn't find any public charging stations.  He warned that while the Model X's range should theoretically be sufficient, the significant elevation changes mean it might not be, even if the car's system indicates otherwise.  He emphasized the importance of planning to avoid getting stranded.  The Model X is advertised as having a 348-mile range by Tesla, but factors like cold weather can reduce this.  Van Kuijck mentioned that during his month-long trip preparation, he realized the Tesla's range might not be enough due to the cold and hilly terrain.  Instead of trying to drive the entire remote section in one go, he chose to stop midway and use a slow charge at an RV park overnight on his way to Alaska. He explained he remained calm and was prepared to wait as long as needed for charging.  He only needed a small 10% battery boost to successfully navigate the dead zone.  On his return journey, he drove at 42 mph in a 65 mph zone to save energy, turned off the car's climate control, disconnected an external battery, and eventually stopped at a lodge to recharge.  Without cell service, Tesla's navigation system was useless for two days.  It couldn't map charging points without GPS and cell connectivity. Van Kuijck described the car's navigation as confused, giving contradictory range predictions. He also noted that the trip wouldn't have been possible a month later, as the RV park and lodge charging spots close after the first snowfall.  Despite these challenges, Van Kuijck expressed surprise at seeing other EV owners in Alaska, including a Tesla Model Y resident. He concluded that while reaching Alaska in an EV is challenging, it's achievable with patience and a sense of adventure.
translated_content: Seorang pencipta kandungan yang mendokumentasikan kehidupannya dengan Tesla telah membuat keputusan untuk memulakan perjalanan ke Alaska, khususnya memandu melalui kawasan terpencil Lebuhraya Alcan sepanjang 320 batu. Walaupun sesetengah pemilik kenderaan elektrik telah melaporkan pengalaman negatif dalam perjalanan jauh, Sandro van Kuijck, yang telah tinggal di dalam Tesla beliau selama setahun dan memandunya merentasi 49 negeri AS, memberitahu Business Insider bahawa beliau tidak sering berasa bimbang tentang kehabisan bateri. Beliau menyatakan tujuannya adalah untuk menguji Model X beliau di salah satu kawasan paling terpencil di Amerika bagi membuktikan kenderaan elektrik cukup serba guna untuk sebarang destinasi. Van Kuijck mengakui bahawa walaupun dengan kepakaran beliau dalam perjalanan kenderaan elektrik, perjalanan ke Alaska ini tetap menimbulkan beberapa masalah. Semasa perjalanan pergi balik selama sembilan hari dari Oregon ke Alaska, beliau perlu memantau dengan teliti jarak perjalanan bateri Model X beliau, terutamanya ketika melalui kawasan 320 batu di Lebuhraya Alcan di mana beliau kehilangan liputan telefon dan tidak dapat mencari stesen pengecas awam. Beliau memberi amaran bahawa walaupun jarak perjalanan Model X sepatutnya mencukupi secara teori, perubahan ketinggian yang ketara boleh menyebabkan ia tidak mencukupi, walaupun sistem kereta menunjukkan sebaliknya. Beliau menekankan kepentingan perancangan awal untuk mengelakkan daripada terkandas. Model X diiklankan mempunyai jarak perjalanan sejauh 348 batu oleh Tesla, tetapi faktor seperti cuaca sejuk boleh mengurangkan jarak ini. Van Kuijck menyebut bahawa semasa persediaan perjalanan selama sebulan, beliau menyedari bahawa jarak perjalanan Tesla mungkin tidak mencukupi disebabkan oleh cuaca sejuk dan kawasan berbukit. Daripada cuba memandu seluruh kawasan terpencil itu dalam satu hari, beliau memilih untuk berhenti di pertengahan jalan dan menggunakan pengecasan perlahan di tapak RV semalaman semasa dalam perjalanan ke Alaska. Beliau menjelaskan bahawa beliau tetap tenang dan bersedia untuk menunggu selama mana yang diperlukan untuk mengecas. Beliau hanya memerlukan tambahan 10% bateri untuk berjaya mengharungi kawasan tanpa liputan itu. Dalam perjalanan pulang, beliau memandu pada kelajuan 42 mph dalam zon 65 mph untuk menjimatkan tenaga, mematikan kawalan suhu kereta, mencabut bateri luaran, dan akhirnya berhenti di sebuah rumah penginapan berdekatan untuk mengecas. Tanpa liputan telefon, sistem navigasi Tesla tidak dapat digunakan selama dua hari itu. Sistem tersebut tidak dapat memetakan stesen pengecasan di sepanjang laluan beliau tanpa akses kepada GPS dan liputan telefon. Van Kuijck menyifatkan sistem navigasi kereta itu sebagai ‘benar-benar keliru’. Sistem itu memberitahunya bahawa beliau boleh sampai ke stesen pengecasan, tetapi kemudian di pertengahan jalan, sistem itu memberitahu beliau bahawa beliau tidak akan sampai dan beliau perlu berpatah balik. Beliau juga menambah bahawa perjalanan itu tidak mungkin dapat dilakukan jika beliau bertolak sebulan kemudian kerana tapak RV dan rumah penginapan di mana beliau mengecas di pertengahan jalan itu akan ditutup selepas salji pertama musim ini. Walaupun menghadapi beberapa kesukaran sepanjang perjalanan, Van Kuijck menyatakan rasa terkejut apabila melihat pemilik kenderaan elektrik lain di Alaska, termasuk pemilik Tesla lain yang tinggal di dalam Model Y mereka. "Memang sangat sukar untuk sampai ke sana dan balik, tetapi ia sangat boleh dilakukan jika anda mempunyai sedikit kesabaran dan anda terbuka kepada pengembaraan," kata Van Kuijck.

article_content: The United States government is once again providing free COVID-19 tests that can be delivered right to your home.  In anticipation of the usual increase in illnesses during the winter holidays, they are offering another set of four at-home virus tests.  If you didn't order tests back in September, you can now get up to eight tests starting this Monday by visiting COVIDtests.gov. The best part is, the U.S. Postal Service will deliver them to you without any charge.  These free coronavirus tests are being distributed as the flu season begins and there's been a rise in RSV cases in some areas of the country.  While hospitalizations related to COVID-19 had increased earlier this fall, they have stabilized in recent weeks.  It's believed that immunity from past vaccinations and infections is helping to keep case numbers lower than in previous years.  This new distribution of free nasal swab tests also comes as insurance companies are no longer required to cover the cost of these tests, marking the first winter since the pandemic began without this coverage.  Currently, you can expect to pay around $11 out-of-pocket for an at-home test, according to research by KFF, a health research nonprofit.  Furthermore, the Food and Drug Administration gave the green light to updated COVID-19 vaccines in September, hoping to boost protection for Americans throughout the winter.  These new shots are designed to target the Omicron XBB.1.5 variant, replacing older vaccines that were made for the original coronavirus strain and an earlier version of Omicron.  Vaccination is recommended for everyone aged six months and older, but unfortunately, not many people have been getting the shots.  Over the past three years since the pandemic began, American taxpayers have invested a significant amount of money – tens of billions of dollars – into developing COVID-19 tests, vaccines, and treatments.

Pada masa ini, anda boleh menjangkakan untuk membayar sekitar $11 daripada poket sendiri untuk kit ujian di rumah, menurut penyelidikan oleh KFF, sebuah badan bukan untung penyelidikan kesihatan. Tambahan pula, Pentadbiran Makanan dan Ubat-ubatan telah memberi kelulusan kepada vaksin COVID-19 yang dikemas kini pada bulan September, dengan harapan untuk meningkatkan perlindungan untuk rakyat Amerika sepanjang musim sejuk. article_content: Saudi security forces in Buraida arrested approximately 160 individuals early Friday morning for protesting unlawfully outside the city's Bureau of Investigation and Prosecution, according to the Saudi Press Agency. The Qassim police spokesman stated that among those arrested were 15 women and 6 children, part of a total of 161 people initially reported. He added that officers at the scene attempted to persuade the protesters to end their demonstration before making arrests. Buraida, the capital of Qassim Province, is known as a deeply conservative region within Saudi Arabia and has experienced several small protests in recent months. Demonstrators have consistently gathered to demand the release of relatives they claim have been jailed for years without charges, trials, or access to legal counsel. Human rights activists in Saudi Arabia indicate that this recent demonstration was triggered by increasing anger over the arrest of numerous female protesters in Buraida earlier in the week. Activists report that around 28 women, many accompanied by their children, had gathered in Buraida on Monday to advocate for the release of detained family members. Amnesty International issued a statement on Friday criticizing these arrests. Their release stated, 'According to reports, those arrested this morning have been moved to Tarfiyah prison, east of Buraida, while those detained since February 27 remain at the central prison in Buraida. No one has been allowed contact with the outside world.' Philip Luther, Amnesty International's Director for the Middle East and North Africa program, described the situation as 'outrageous', stating, 'Instead of persecuting peaceful protesters, Saudi Authorities should heed their demands and release all those held merely for exercising their human rights.' One female protester from Monday's demonstration told CNN by phone, requesting anonymity for safety reasons, that despite being surrounded by police and fearing arrest, they would remain until their demands were met. She stated, 'We are calling for the release of our family members, like my husband, who has been unlawfully jailed for years. And we demand the removal of Interior Minister Mohammed Bin Nayef.' Saudi human rights activists reported that after spending the night at the protest site, the women and children were arrested late Tuesday evening after erecting three tents and declaring their intent to continue their sit-in. Amateur videos posted online reportedly showed women holding signs demanding the release of imprisoned relatives, displaying placards stating they were not afraid of the Interior Minister, and chanting slogans such as, 'The people call for the liberation of the prisons.' In at least one video, female protesters reportedly burned a picture of Prince Mohammed, the recently appointed Interior Minister, a particularly bold act in the absolute monarchy. Prince Mohammed is a high-ranking Saudi official with authority over the police, counterterrorism forces, special forces, and religious police. Demonstrations are prohibited in Saudi Arabia, a conservative nation that did not experience large-scale protests during the Arab Spring. Frederic Wehrey, a senior associate at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, commented that while burning the Interior Minister's picture is significant in such a conservative area, 'we are still far from a coordinated movement that could challenge the ruling family.' However, he noted that dissenting voices in the kingdom have been increasing. Rights activists claim the Saudi government has detained thousands in connection with counterterrorism efforts, leading to growing public anger. In his Friday statement, the Qassim police spokesman said those arrested on Thursday 'will be referred to the competent authorities to complete the legal procedures against them.' He described the Buraida gathering as 'an attempt to manipulate public opinion by exploiting individuals accused and convicted of activities of deviant groups.' The term 'deviant groups' is typically used by the Saudi government to refer to terrorist groups. Many relatives of detainees deny any connection to terrorism and state their loved ones have been detained for extended periods without trial or legal access. Activists report that sit-ins and demonstrations have increased in the past two years as a result of these issues. Abdulaziz Al-Shubaily, an activist and member of the Saudi Civil and Political Rights Association, stated, 'many prisoners have been jailed for years without charges. There's no reason for that. If you are not going to charge someone, you should release them.' Activists also reported that women protesters and children were arrested in early January and February for similar protests demanding the release of jailed relatives. These arrests sparked further small-scale demonstrations in other cities. When questioned in late January about claims that detained relatives are political prisoners, Interior Ministry Spokesman Major Gen. Mansour Al-Turki told CNN that Saudi officials would not comment on cases 'being looked at by the courts.' In Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province, larger protests by the Shiite minority have sometimes become violent, with demonstrators demanding not only the release of political prisoners but also equal rights. Wehrey describes the prisoner issue as 'the most explosive grievance in the kingdom right now.' However, he believes it 'will remain contained' as 'the ruling family still possesses considerable resources to co-opt and repress dissent and presents itself as essential for national unity in a volatile region.'
translated_content: Pasukan keselamatan Saudi di Buraida telah menahan kira-kira 160 individu pada awal pagi Jumaat kerana melakukan protes yang menyalahi undang-undang di luar Biro Penyiasatan dan Pendakwaan bandar itu, menurut Agensi Akhbar Saudi. Jurucakap polis Qassim menyatakan bahawa antara mereka yang ditahan adalah 15 wanita dan 6 kanak-kanak, sebahagian daripada jumlah 161 orang yang dilaporkan pada awalnya. Beliau menambah bahawa pegawai di tempat kejadian cuba memujuk para penunjuk perasaan untuk menamatkan demonstrasi mereka sebelum melakukan penangkapan. Buraida, ibu negeri Wilayah Qassim, dikenali sebagai wilayah yang sangat konservatif di Arab Saudi dan telah mengalami beberapa protes kecil dalam beberapa bulan kebelakangan ini. Para penunjuk perasaan secara konsisten berkumpul untuk menuntut pembebasan saudara mara yang mereka dakwa telah dipenjarakan selama bertahun-tahun tanpa pertuduhan, perbicaraan, atau akses kepada peguam. Aktivis hak asasi manusia di Arab Saudi menunjukkan bahawa demonstrasi baru-baru ini dicetuskan oleh peningkatan kemarahan terhadap penangkapan ramai penunjuk perasaan wanita di Buraida pada awal minggu ini. Aktivis melaporkan bahawa sekitar 28 wanita, banyak yang ditemani anak-anak mereka, telah berkumpul di Buraida pada hari Isnin untuk menyokong pembebasan ahli keluarga yang ditahan. Amnesty International mengeluarkan kenyataan pada hari Jumaat yang mengkritik penangkapan ini. Kenyataan mereka berbunyi, 'Menurut laporan, mereka yang ditangkap pagi ini telah dipindahkan ke penjara Tarfiyah, timur Buraida, manakala mereka yang ditahan sejak 27 Februari kekal di penjara pusat Buraida. Tiada siapa yang dibenarkan berhubung dengan dunia luar.' Philip Luther, Pengarah Amnesty International untuk program Timur Tengah dan Afrika Utara, menyifatkan keadaan itu sebagai 'keterlaluan', dan menyatakan, 'Daripada menganiaya penunjuk perasaan aman, Pihak Berkuasa Saudi patut mendengar tuntutan mereka dan membebaskan semua yang ditahan hanya kerana menjalankan hak asasi manusia mereka.' Seorang penunjuk perasaan wanita dari demonstrasi hari Isnin memberitahu CNN melalui telefon, dan meminta identitinya dirahsiakan atas sebab keselamatan, bahawa walaupun dikelilingi polis dan takut ditangkap, mereka akan kekal di situ sehingga tuntutan mereka dipenuhi. Beliau menyatakan, 'Kami menyeru agar ahli keluarga kami dibebaskan, seperti suami saya, yang telah dipenjarakan secara tidak sah selama bertahun-tahun. Dan kami menuntut agar Menteri Dalam Negeri Mohammed Bin Nayef dipecat.' Aktivis hak asasi manusia Saudi melaporkan bahawa selepas bermalam di tapak protes, wanita dan kanak-kanak itu ditangkap lewat petang Selasa selepas mendirikan tiga khemah dan mengisytiharkan niat untuk meneruskan duduk bantah mereka. Video amatur yang disiarkan dalam talian dilaporkan menunjukkan wanita memegang tanda yang menuntut pembebasan saudara mara yang dipenjarakan, memaparkan plakad yang menyatakan bahawa mereka tidak takut kepada Menteri Dalam Negeri, dan melaungkan slogan seperti, 'Rakyat menyeru pembebasan penjara!' Dalam sekurang-kurangnya satu video, penunjuk perasaan wanita dilaporkan membakar gambar Putera Mohammed, Menteri Dalam Negeri yang baru dilantik, satu tindakan yang sangat berani dalam sebuah negara monarki mutlak. Putera Mohammed ialah seorang pegawai kanan Saudi yang mempunyai kuasa ke atas polis, pasukan anti-keganasan, pasukan khas, dan polis agama. Demonstrasi adalah dilarang di Arab Saudi, sebuah negara konservatif yang tidak pernah mengalami protes berskala besar semasa Musim Bunga Arab. Frederic Wehrey, seorang felo kanan di Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, mengulas bahawa walaupun membakar gambar Menteri Dalam Negeri adalah sesuatu yang signifikan di kawasan konservatif seperti itu, 'kita masih jauh daripada gerakan bersepadu yang boleh mencabar keluarga diraja.' Namun begitu, beliau menyatakan bahawa suara-suara yang berbeza pendapat di kerajaan telah meningkat. Aktivis hak asasi mendakwa kerajaan Saudi telah menahan beribu-ribu orang berkaitan dengan usaha anti-keganasan, yang membawa kepada peningkatan kemarahan orang awam. Dalam kenyataan pada hari Jumaat, jurucakap polis Qassim berkata bahawa mereka yang ditangkap pada hari Khamis 'akan dirujuk kepada pihak berkuasa yang kompeten untuk melengkapkan prosedur undang-undang terhadap mereka.' Beliau menyifatkan perhimpunan di Buraida sebagai 'percobaan untuk memanipulasi pendapat awam dengan mengeksploitasi individu yang dituduh dan disabitkan kesalahan dengan aktiviti kumpulan sesat.' Istilah 'kumpulan sesat' biasanya digunakan oleh kerajaan Saudi untuk merujuk kepada kumpulan pengganas. Ramai saudara-mara tahanan menafikan sebarang kaitan dengan keganasan dan menyatakan bahawa orang yang mereka sayangi telah ditahan untuk tempoh yang lama tanpa perbicaraan atau akses kepada bantuan guaman. Aktivis melaporkan bahawa tindakan duduk bantah dan demonstrasi telah meningkat dalam tempoh dua tahun yang lalu akibat isu-isu ini. Abdulaziz Al-Shubaily, seorang aktivis dan ahli Persatuan Hak Sivil dan Politik Saudi, menyatakan, 'ramai tahanan telah dipenjarakan selama bertahun-tahun tanpa pertuduhan. Tiada alasan untuk itu. Jika anda tidak akan menuduh seseorang, anda harus membebaskan mereka.' Aktivis juga melaporkan bahawa penunjuk perasaan wanita dan kanak-kanak telah ditangkap pada awal bulan Januari dan Februari untuk protes serupa yang menuntut pembebasan saudara-mara yang dipenjarakan. Penangkapan ini telah mencetuskan demonstrasi berskala kecil yang lebih banyak di bandar-bandar lain. Apabila ditanya pada lewat bulan Januari mengenai dakwaan bahawa saudara-mara yang ditahan adalah tahanan politik, Jurucakap Kementerian Dalam Negeri Mejar Jeneral Mansour Al-Turki memberitahu CNN bahawa pegawai-pegawai Saudi tidak akan mengulas mengenai kes-kes 'yang sedang disiasat oleh mahkamah.' Di Wilayah Timur Arab Saudi, protes yang lebih besar oleh golongan minoriti Syiah kadangkala bertukar menjadi ganas, dengan penunjuk perasaan menuntut bukan sahaja pembebasan tahanan politik tetapi juga hak yang sama rata. Wehrey menyifatkan isu tahanan sebagai 'isu yang paling membimbangkan di negara ini pada masa ini.' Walau bagaimanapun, beliau percaya isu ini 'akan terus terkawal' kerana 'keluarga diraja masih memiliki sumber yang besar untuk memujuk dan menindas perbezaan pendapat dan menampilkan diri mereka sebagai penting untuk perpaduan negara di rantau yang tidak stabil.'

article_content: A haunting melody that once soothed children on a Titanic lifeboat, helping them ignore the cries of those dying, has been revived. This song originated from a musical pig toy owned by Edith Rosenbaum, an American fashion journalist who was 32 years old during the tragic 1912 sinking. Rosenbaum and her pig survived the disaster, but the toy's music mechanism did not.  Now, 101 years later, the National Maritime Museum has repaired the musical toy and recorded its tune. The musical pig was a cherished item of Edith Rosenbaum, who, as an American fashion journalist, experienced the Titanic tragedy at age 32. 'It gave me goosebumps,' Rory McEvoy, a museum curator, told MailOnline about hearing the melody.  'We never thought this would be possible. It was both incredibly exciting and unsettling.' Researchers played the song sparingly to prevent further damage to the fragile toy.  They recorded it hoping the public could help identify the tune. In a 1970 interview, Rosenbaum recounted how her musical pig was instrumental in her rescue, as she initially hesitated to leave the Titanic. 'I wouldn't have left the ship,' she explained, 'but a sailor approached and said, “Hey, do you not want to be saved? Well, I'll save your baby,” and he grabbed the pig from under my arm and tossed it into a lifeboat.' Rosenbaum followed her toy pig into the lifeboat and used its music to comfort children during the seven hours before rescue. Teresa Thorne portrays Edith Rosenbaum, the owner of the lucky pig, in the 1958 film 'A Night to Remember'. During the agonizing seven hours awaiting rescue from the Titanic, Rosenbaum and her musical pig comforted children in a nearby lifeboat. Due to the risk of irreparable damage, the museum team used high-resolution X-ray equipment to examine the pig's internal structure. Two scans were performed: one to detail the main body and another for clear images of the musical mechanism. They discovered the pig was made of organic materials, including wood and papier-mâché. McEvoy explained that a copper sheet was used to filter lower energy radiation during the mechanism scan. A rendered image displayed the inner structure of the toy. The scan revealed the tail was a decorative vellum piece, not connected to the music box. Initially, they believed the music was spring-driven and activated by pulling the tail. However, scans showed it was hand-powered. 'By examining a cross-section, we found a hairpin causing a rattle. It was likely used to fix the music box after the crank broke off,' McEvoy noted in his blog. 'The S-shaped object in the center seems to be the original crank-handle and tail.' 'Close inspection shows this object is a skin-covered metal tube, a surprising and thrilling discovery, possibly requiring key-hole surgery,' McEvoy added. The second scan revealed a toothed wheel connected to the pin barrel, driven by a worm gear on the crankshaft. A distinctive star logo marked the comb, which researchers hope will help identify the maker. 'This is just the start of our study. These 3D models are invaluable for our curatorial inquiries and the long-term preservation of these remarkable objects,' McEvoy concluded. The pig became part of the Museum's Lord-MacQuitty collection in 2003.
translated_content: Sebuah melodi menghantui yang pernah menenangkan kanak-kanak di atas bot penyelamat Titanic, membantu mereka mengabaikan tangisan mereka yang sedang nazak, kini telah dihidupkan semula. Lagu ini berasal daripada mainan babi berlagu kepunyaan Edith Rosenbaum, seorang wartawan fesyen Amerika yang berusia 32 tahun ketika tragedi karam Titanic pada tahun 1912. Rosenbaum dan babi peliharaannya terselamat dalam bencana itu, tetapi mekanisme muzik mainan tersebut tidak. Kini, 101 tahun selepas kejadian, Muzium Maritim Negara telah membaiki mainan berlagu itu dan merakamkan melodinya. Babi berlagu itu merupakan barang kesayangan Edith Rosenbaum, seorang wartawan fesyen Amerika yang mengalami tragedi Titanic ketika berusia 32 tahun. 'Ia membuatkan saya meremang,' kata Rory McEvoy, seorang kurator muzium, kepada MailOnline tentang pengalamannya mendengar melodi tersebut. 'Kami tidak pernah menyangka perkara ini mungkin berlaku. Ia sungguh mengujakan dan pada masa yang sama agak menyeramkan.' Para penyelidik memainkan lagu tersebut hanya beberapa kali sahaja untuk mengelakkan kerosakan lanjut pada mainan yang rapuh itu. Mereka merakamkannya dengan harapan orang ramai dapat membantu mengenal pasti lagu tersebut. Dalam temu bual pada tahun 1970, Rosenbaum menceritakan bagaimana babi berlagunya memainkan peranan penting dalam menyelamatkannya, kerana pada mulanya dia teragak-agak untuk meninggalkan kapal Titanic. 'Saya tidak mahu meninggalkan kapal itu,' jelasnya, 'tetapi seorang kelasi datang dan berkata, “Cik, awak tak nak diselamatkan ke? Baiklah, saya akan selamatkan ‘bayi’ awak,” lalu dia merampas babi ini dari bawah lengan saya dan mencampakkannya ke dalam bot penyelamat.' Rosenbaum kemudiannya mengikuti babi berlagunya ke dalam bot penyelamat dan menggunakan muzik tersebut untuk menenangkan kanak-kanak selama tujuh jam sebelum mereka diselamatkan. Teresa Thorne melakonkan watak Edith Rosenbaum, pemilik babi bertuah itu, dalam filem tahun 1958 yang berjudul 'A Night to Remember'. Semasa tujuh jam yang mendebarkan menunggu penyelamatan dari Titanic, Rosenbaum dan babi berlagunya menenangkan kanak-kanak di dalam bot penyelamat yang berdekatan. Disebabkan risiko kerosakan yang tidak dapat diperbaiki, pasukan muzium menggunakan peralatan X-ray beresolusi tinggi untuk memeriksa struktur dalaman babi tersebut. Dua imbasan telah dilakukan: satu untuk memerinci bahagian badan utama dan satu lagi untuk mendapatkan imej yang jelas tentang mekanisme muzik. Mereka mendapati bahawa babi tersebut diperbuat daripada bahan organik, termasuk kayu dan papier-mâché. McEvoy menjelaskan bahawa kepingan tembaga digunakan untuk menapis sinaran tenaga rendah semasa imbasan mekanisme. Imej yang dihasilkan menunjukkan struktur dalaman mainan tersebut. Imbasan itu mendedahkan bahawa ekor tersebut hanyalah hiasan velum, dan tidak disambungkan ke kotak muzik. Pada mulanya, mereka menyangka muzik tersebut menggunakan spring dan diaktifkan dengan menarik ekornya. Namun, imbasan menunjukkan bahawa ia sebenarnya dikuasakan oleh tangan. 'Dengan memeriksa keratan rentas, kami menemui pin rambut yang menyebabkan bunyi berdetar. Ia mungkin digunakan untuk membaiki kotak muzik tersebut selepas engkolnya patah,' jelas McEvoy dalam blognya. 'Objek berbentuk S di tengah itu dipercayai merupakan engkol dan ekor yang asal.' 'Pemeriksaan teliti menunjukkan bahawa objek ini ialah tiub logam yang disaluti kulit, satu penemuan yang mengejutkan dan mendebarkan, dan mungkin memerlukan pembedahan lubang kunci,' tambah McEvoy. Imbasan kedua mendedahkan roda bergigi yang disambungkan ke tong pin, yang dipacu oleh gear cacing di hujung aci engkol. Logo bintang yang tersendiri menandakan sikat tersebut, dan para penyelidik berharap ini akan membantu mereka mengenal pasti pembuatnya. 'Ini hanyalah permulaan kajian kami. Model 3D ini amat berharga untuk pertanyaan kuratorial kami serta pemeliharaan jangka panjang objek yang luar biasa ini,' simpul McEvoy. Babi tersebut menjadi sebahagian daripada koleksi Lord-MacQuitty Muzium pada tahun 2003.

article_content: Prince William and Kate Middleton, who are soon to be married, made a nostalgic return to St. Andrews University in Scotland this Friday. This was the place where their relationship first blossomed. Prince William, in his role as patron for the university's 600th Anniversary Appeal, officially inaugurated the celebratory event. He examined the ancient Papal Bull, a set of letters from the Pope dating back to 1413, and then revealed a commemorative plaque for the gathered students and faculty.  Prince William, who is second in line to inherit the British throne, was an art history student at St. Andrews when he initially crossed paths with Kate in 2001. Their bond deepened after they moved into a shared residence with two other friends, and they reportedly began dating around late 2003. Both graduated in 2005. Mark Saunders, a royal expert for CNN, commented that Catherine might feel quite emotional during the visit. He noted that she arrived at St. Andrews as an ordinary student but is now returning as someone destined to become Queen of England.  Saunders also jokingly mentioned that the university claims to have the highest rate of student marriages in Great Britain, suggesting that the town's small size might encourage romance.  As a wedding present, the university has created a scholarship in honor of these two alumni. University head Louise Richardson stated that they were very happy to offer this scholarship as a wedding present and were thrilled that the couple accepted it. This visit marks the second official duty for the couple, following their launch of a lifeboat in Anglesey, North Wales, the previous day. They currently reside in Anglesey where Prince William works as a helicopter pilot for the RAF search and rescue service. Their initial official engagement was intentionally kept low-profile to gradually introduce Middleton to the public aspects of royal life.

Rektor Universiti, Louise Richardson, menyatakan bahawa mereka amat berbesar hati untuk menawarkan biasiswa ini sebagai hadiah perkahwinan dan gembira kerana pasangan diraja tersebut menerimanya. Mereka kini tinggal di Anglesey di mana Putera William berkhidmat sebagai juruterbang helikopter mencari dan menyelamat untuk RAF. Acara rasmi pertama mereka sengaja diadakan secara sederhana, bertujuan untuk memperkenalkan Middleton secara beransur-ansur kepada kehidupan diraja di mata umum.

article_content: Four new victims have come forward to make shocking claims about a vampire-obsessed trucker who they say held them captive and kept them as sex slaves over an extended period of time. Timothy Jay Vafeades of Salt Lake City, Utah, has already been charged with kidnapping and abusing two women, one a relative, after he allegedly forced them to travel around the country in his truck while repeatedly having sex with them against their will. Vafeades, who wears fangs, named his truck the 'Twilight Express,' most likely in reference to the popular vampire series. Creep: Four new victims have come forward to say they were held as sex slaves by Timothy Jay Vafeades, a vampire-obsessed trucker who enjoys wearing fangs. Shortly after he was arrested, a second woman came forward with similar claims. Vafeades is also being charged with possession of child pornography after authorities found hundreds of child porn videos and images on his computer.

article_content: A U.S. Army soldier died and two others were injured in a shooting at Fort Bragg, North Carolina, on Thursday. Authorities reported that a soldier shot two others before turning the gun on himself. All three soldiers belonged to the 525th Battlefield Surveillance Brigade, according to a statement from the military installation. Fort Bragg spokesman Col. Kevin Arata stated that the shooting took place during a unit safety briefing. The suspected shooter was injured and is now in custody. A third soldier sustained minor injuries in the incident, which happened within a unit area, Arata added. "The reasons behind the shooting are still unknown, and we are collaborating with the unit and the families involved to support them during this difficult time," Arata said. He also mentioned that notifications to the next of kin are being carried out. Special agents from the Army Criminal Investigation Command are currently at Fort Bragg and are conducting an investigation. Reports about a missing Fort Bragg soldier are also circulating. More details on this story are available from WTVD and WGHP.

article_content: Tributes have poured in for Leonard Nimoy, who passed away on Friday due to complications from lung disease. Among the many homages, Colonel Terry Virts, an astronaut, posted a poignant photo on Saturday from the International Space Station. The image showed Virts performing the Vulcan salute, a gesture made famous by Nimoy's character Spock in Star Trek, through the ISS window overlooking Earth. Virts, who has piloted the space shuttle Endeavor and commanded Expedition 43, shared the photo without a caption, letting the iconic 'V' hand sign speak for itself. This salute is often accompanied by the phrase 'Live long and prosper.' Back on Earth, a makeshift memorial appeared at Nimoy's star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. Fans, known as Trekkies, left flowers, notes, and photos, including one of Nimoy with William Shatner, who played Captain Kirk. Fellow Star Trek actors, including Shatner and Jonathan Frakes from 'Star Trek: The Next Generation,' also shared online condolences. Frakes tweeted, '#LLAP RIP to the best First Officer,' using the abbreviation for 'Live Long and Prosper,' a phrase deeply associated with Nimoy's Spock. Zachary Quinto, who portrayed Spock in the Star Trek reboot films, expressed his grief on Instagram, posting a photo of Nimoy with the caption: 'my heart is broken. i love you profoundly my dear friend. and i will miss you everyday. may flights of angels sing thee to thy rest.'

article_content: A metrobus crashed through the barrier of the Queen Elizabeth Bridge in Johannesburg, landing on the road beneath. The incident occurred this morning in Braamfontein, Johannesburg, South Africa. Despite the severity of the crash, no fatalities occurred, and the driver sustained only minor injuries. The bus broke through a section of the bridge's cement wall before falling onto the road. Local news sources reported that the driver was the sole occupant of the bus at the time of the accident. Johannesburg Metro Police spokesperson Edna Mamonyane confirmed that no passengers were on board. She stated the bus was situated near the parking lot of Park Station and that Mandela Bridge was closed at its connection to Queen Elizabeth Bridge. Metrobus spokesperson Esther Dreyer mentioned the driver had started his shift just after 6 am from the depot and the crash happened shortly thereafter. A replacement bus was dispatched to minimize disruption for commuters. Dreyer added that the bus was mechanically sound and suggested wet road conditions might have contributed to the skid. The front of the bus was damaged from the impact and surrounded by debris. A large area around the wreckage was cordoned off, and several roads were closed as emergency services worked to remove the bus. Personnel from Johannesburg Metro Police, emergency services, and Johannesburg Road Agency attended the scene. Passersby took photographs of the bus from the bridge, and the accident caused significant traffic congestion throughout the city. Police are currently investigating the cause of the crash.

article_content: In an unusual turn of events, a fisherman in Russia owes his life to an unexpected source: Justin Bieber. Igor Vorozhbitsyn, 42, was attacked by a brown bear while walking to his preferred fishing location in the Yakutia Republic, northern Russia. He believed his encounter would be fatal. However, as the bear began to attack, Igor's mobile phone unexpectedly started ringing. The ringtone, Justin Bieber's popular song 'Baby', filled the air. Surprisingly, the bear immediately stopped its attack and retreated into the nearby forest. Wildlife specialists suggest that the sudden, unfamiliar sound of the ringtone likely startled the bear, causing it to abandon its attack. One expert commented that a sudden shock can indeed deter an aggressive bear, and a Justin Bieber ringtone would certainly be an unexpected sound for such an animal. Although brown bears are known to be dangerous and capable of killing humans, this incident demonstrates that they can also be easily frightened away. Igor Vorozhbitsyn sustained cuts and bruises to his face and chest. He was later found by fellow fishermen after using his phone to call for assistance and is now recovering from the ordeal. Recounting the incident, Mr. Vorozhbitsyn explained, 'After parking my car, I was heading towards my fishing spot when I felt a massive impact on my back, and a bear was on top of me.' He added, 'I was incredibly lucky that my phone rang at that moment, causing it to run away. I know that sort of ringtone might not be for everyone, but my granddaughter put it on my phone as a joke.' Adult brown bears can reach weights of up to 600kg and are known to be formidable creatures, even capable of overpowering wolves and Siberian tigers.

article_content: Five Somali men have been convicted in the Netherlands and sentenced to five years in prison for plotting a hijack at sea, according to a report by CNN affiliate RTL on Thursday. The trial, considered the first modern European pirate trial, commenced at the Rotterdam District Court on May 25. The men were apprehended by the Danish navy in January 2009 in the Gulf of Aden, off the coast of Somalia, after they attacked a cargo vessel sailing under a Dutch Antilles flag, stated Wim de Bruin, spokesperson for the Netherlands National Prosecutor's Office. "The Danish navy destroyed the pirates' ship, and the pirates were captured and handed over to Dutch authorities," he explained. The convicted pirates are identified as Ahmed Yusuf Farah, 25; Jama Mohamed Samatar, 45; Abdirisaq Abdulahi Hirsi, 33; Sayid Ali Garaar, 39; and Osman Musse Farah, 32, de Bruin noted. They could have faced sentences ranging from nine to twelve years, he added. In a separate case, another Somali man suspected of piracy is awaiting sentencing in the United States, having pleaded guilty in May to hijacking and kidnapping. Prosecutors allege that Abduwali Abdukhadir Muse spearheaded an attack on the U.S.-flagged vessel Maersk Alabama off the African coast last year. Muse admitted guilt on May 19 in a New York federal court to felony charges of maritime vessel hijacking, kidnapping, and hostage-taking related to the Maersk Alabama hijacking in the Indian Ocean on April 8, 2009. Muse potentially faces a maximum prison term of nearly 34 years when he is sentenced on October 19. Spokesman de Bruin mentioned that the pirates tried in the Netherlands spent four weeks on a Danish navy ship following their capture before being transported to the Netherlands. They were detained in pre-trial custody while the court heard testimonies from Danish navy personnel and crew members of the Dutch Antilles cargo ship that was attacked, he said. Five Dutch defense lawyers represented the suspects, according to de Bruin. He reiterated that this trial marks a European first. Germany is also preparing to prosecute 10 suspected pirates captured in the Gulf of Aden earlier this year. These suspects were arrested after attempting to board a German cargo vessel, but the Danish navy intervened to stop the hijacking and transferred them to Dutch authorities, Bruin stated. They have been held in the Netherlands since then, and Germany requested their extradition approximately two months prior. CNN's Richard Allen Greene and Eileen Hsieh contributed to this report.
translated_content: Lima lelaki Somalia telah disabitkan kesalahan di Belanda dan dijatuhi hukuman penjara lima tahun kerana merancang rompakan di laut, menurut laporan oleh RTL, sebuah afiliasi CNN, pada hari Khamis. Perbicaraan ini, yang dianggap sebagai perbicaraan lanun Eropah moden yang pertama, bermula di Mahkamah Daerah Rotterdam pada 25 Mei. Lelaki-lelaki itu ditangkap oleh tentera laut Denmark pada Januari 2009 di Teluk Aden, di luar pantai Somalia, selepas mereka menyerang sebuah kapal kargo yang berlayar di bawah bendera Antillen Belanda, kata Wim de Bruin, jurucakap Pejabat Pendakwa Raya Kebangsaan Belanda. "Tentera laut Denmark memusnahkan kapal lanun itu, dan lanun-lanun itu ditangkap dan diserahkan kepada pihak berkuasa Belanda," jelasnya. Lanun-lanun yang disabitkan kesalahan itu dikenal pasti sebagai Ahmed Yusuf Farah, 25; Jama Mohamed Samatar, 45; Abdirisaq Abdulahi Hirsi, 33; Sayid Ali Garaar, 39; dan Osman Musse Farah, 32, kata de Bruin. Mereka boleh menghadapi hukuman penjara antara sembilan hingga dua belas tahun, tambahnya. Dalam kes berasingan, seorang lagi lelaki Somalia yang disyaki lanun sedang menunggu hukuman di Amerika Syarikat, setelah mengaku bersalah pada bulan Mei atas tuduhan rompakan dan penculikan. Pendakwa raya mendakwa bahawa Abduwali Abdukhadir Muse mengetuai serangan ke atas kapal berbendera A.S., Maersk Alabama, di luar pantai Afrika tahun lepas. Muse mengaku bersalah pada 19 Mei di mahkamah persekutuan New York atas tuduhan jenayah rompakan kapal maritim, penculikan, dan penyanderaan yang berkaitan dengan rompakan Maersk Alabama di Lautan Hindi pada 8 April 2009. Muse berpotensi menghadapi hukuman penjara maksimum hampir 34 tahun apabila dia dijatuhi hukuman pada 19 Oktober. Jurucakap de Bruin menyebut bahawa lanun-lanun yang dibicarakan di Belanda menghabiskan masa selama empat minggu di atas kapal tentera laut Denmark selepas penangkapan mereka sebelum dibawa ke Belanda. Mereka ditahan dalam tahanan pra-perbicaraan sementara mahkamah mendengar keterangan daripada kakitangan tentera laut Denmark dan anak kapal kapal kargo Antillen Belanda yang diserang, katanya. Lima peguam bela Belanda mewakili suspek, menurut de Bruin. Beliau menegaskan bahawa perbicaraan ini menandakan yang pertama di Eropah. Jerman juga sedang bersedia untuk mendakwa 10 suspek lanun yang ditangkap di Teluk Aden awal tahun ini. Suspek-suspek ini ditangkap selepas cuba menaiki sebuah kapal kargo Jerman, tetapi tentera laut Denmark campur tangan untuk menghentikan rompakan itu dan menyerahkan mereka kepada pihak berkuasa Belanda, kata Bruin. Mereka telah ditahan di Belanda sejak itu, dan Jerman meminta ekstradisi mereka kira-kira dua bulan sebelumnya. Richard Allen Greene dan Eileen Hsieh dari CNN menyumbang kepada laporan ini.

article_content: A young woman with Asperger’s syndrome has overcome bullying to secure a place as a UK finalist for the Miss Universe beauty pageant. Lauren Lovejoy, 24, faced daily taunts that she was ‘ugly and weird’ and was even driven to suicidal thoughts. But now she is one of 38 women competing to become the Great Britain representative for the Miss Universe title. Lauren (left aged 13) suffered horrendous bullying throughout her childhood but now feels she has proven her tormentors wrong by reaching the final of the Great Britain Miss Universe competition (right, Lauren today). Lauren said: ‘I never thought I’d make it – there was a point when I believed every bad word the bullies threw at me. ‘They broke my nose and shattered my confidence. In my lowest moments I thought I wanted to end my life. ‘I thought that I really was as ugly and bad as they said.’ Lauren, from Nottingham, entered the Miss Universe competition last year after seeing an advertisement online. Following an interview, she was overjoyed to discover she had been selected as a finalist. She said: ‘The new opportunities I have been given through Miss Universe have opened my eyes – now I feel fantastic. The symptoms of Lauren’s Asperger’s syndrome made her a target for bullies at school (left, age 9, right, 10). ‘When I’m on stage it’s like I take on a different role and I am this confident and sassy young woman. ‘I love to joke and laugh and I wanted that side of me to show. ‘So when I was selected I really felt a sense of achievement that they picked me because they must have really liked me.’ Model Lauren struggles to work in a conventional role due to Asperger’s syndrome, which causes difficulties in social interaction and obsessive behaviour. But finds the unstructured nature of modelling and singing a creative release from her symptoms of anxiety and stress. Lauren said: ‘I am very sensitive to sound and some smells too. ‘I can take things that people say the wrong way too and that can make me very distressed. ‘I like to have the right people around me who understand my needs and who I trust. Lauren is now focusing all her efforts on preparing for the GB final of Miss Universe later this month. ‘I’ve had jobs before but they’ve been a disaster. I never last very long. ‘But Miss Universe have been so supportive of my needs and I feel my confidence building all the time.’ Lauren lives with her partner Phil Brown, 43, in the flat they share in Gamston, Nottingham. He said: ‘I’m so proud of everything that Lauren has achieved so far. ‘She has a lot of people behind her and I really believe she’s going places. ‘We want to properly launch her music career soon too.’ Lauren is now focusing all her efforts on preparing for the GB final of Miss Universe later this month in Cardiff. Lauren says she finds the unstructured nature of modelling and singing a creative release from her symptoms of anxiety and stress. She is also an ambassador for the children’s charity, Strong Bones. She said: ‘I want to help other children to achieve as much as they can after they leave school. ‘I want them to see me doing well after suffering terrible bullying and be inspired.’ Paula Abbandonato, National Director of Miss Universe GB, said: ‘Lauren’s been a fantastic part of the line-up this year. ‘She is a real character and we’ve really enjoyed having her involved. ‘The work she does to raise awareness for Asperger’s sufferers is a great thing. ‘She encourages other girls not to let their insecurities or conditions define them. She’s a real inspiration.’
translated_content: Seorang wanita muda yang menghidap sindrom Asperger telah mengatasi pembulian untuk mendapatkan tempat sebagai finalis UK bagi pertandingan ratu cantik Miss Universe. Lauren Lovejoy, 24, menghadapi ejekan harian bahawa dia ‘hodoh dan pelik’ malah pernah terdorong untuk membunuh diri. Namun kini, dia adalah salah seorang daripada 38 wanita yang bersaing untuk menjadi wakil Great Britain bagi gelaran Miss Universe. Lauren (kiri ketika berusia 13 tahun) mengalami pembulian yang teruk sepanjang zaman kanak-kanaknya tetapi kini merasakan dia telah membuktikan bahawa pembulinya salah dengan mencapai peringkat akhir pertandingan Great Britain Miss Universe (kanan, Lauren hari ini). Pada saat-saat terendah, saya terfikir untuk menamatkan hidup saya sendiri. ‘Saya fikir saya benar-benar sehodoh dan seburuk seperti yang mereka katakan.’ Lauren, dari Nottingham, menyertai pertandingan Miss Universe tahun lepas selepas melihat iklan di internet. Dia berkata: ‘Peluang baharu yang diberikan kepada saya melalui Miss Universe telah membuka mata saya – kini saya berasa sangat hebat. Gejala sindrom Asperger yang dialami Lauren menjadikannya sasaran pembuli di sekolah (kiri, umur 9 tahun, kanan, 10 tahun). ‘Apabila saya berada di atas pentas, rasanya seperti saya mengambil peranan yang berbeza dan menjadi wanita muda yang yakin dan bergaya. ‘Saya suka bergurau dan ketawa, dan saya mahu sisi diri saya itu ditonjolkan. ‘Jadi apabila saya dipilih, saya benar-benar merasakan pencapaian kerana mereka memilih saya, pastinya mereka sangat menyukai saya.’ Sebagai seorang model, Lauren menghadapi kesukaran untuk bekerja dalam peranan konvensional disebabkan sindrom Asperger, yang menyebabkan masalah dalam interaksi sosial dan tingkah laku obsesif. Namun, dia mendapati sifat peragaan dan nyanyian yang tidak berstruktur sebagai pelepasan kreatif daripada gejala kebimbangan dan tekanan yang dialaminya. Lauren berkata: ‘Saya sangat sensitif terhadap bunyi dan beberapa bau juga. ‘Saya boleh salah faham terhadap apa yang orang lain katakan dan itu boleh membuatkan saya sangat tertekan. ‘Saya suka dikelilingi orang yang memahami keperluan saya dan yang saya percayai. Lauren kini menumpukan seluruh usahanya untuk membuat persiapan bagi peringkat akhir GB Miss Universe yang akan berlangsung pada akhir bulan ini. ‘Saya pernah bekerja sebelum ini tetapi semuanya berakhir dengan kegagalan. Saya tidak pernah bertahan lama. ‘Tetapi pihak Miss Universe sangat menyokong keperluan saya dan saya merasakan keyakinan diri saya semakin meningkat setiap masa.’ Lauren tinggal bersama pasangannya, Phil Brown, 43, di flat yang mereka diami bersama di Gamston, Nottingham. Phil berkata: ‘Saya sangat bangga dengan semua yang telah dicapai Lauren setakat ini. ‘Dia mendapat sokongan ramai dan saya benar-benar percaya dia akan berjaya. ‘Kami juga mahu melancarkan kerjaya muziknya dengan betul tidak lama lagi.’ Lauren kini menumpukan seluruh usahanya untuk membuat persiapan bagi peringkat akhir GB Miss Universe yang akan berlangsung pada akhir bulan ini di Cardiff. Lauren mengatakan bahawa dia mendapati sifat peragaan dan nyanyian yang tidak berstruktur sebagai pelepasan kreatif daripada gejala kebimbangan dan tekanannya. Dia juga merupakan duta bagi badan amal kanak-kanak, Strong Bones. Dia berkata: ‘Saya ingin membantu kanak-kanak lain untuk mencapai kejayaan sebanyak mungkin selepas mereka meninggalkan sekolah. ‘Saya mahu mereka melihat kejayaan saya selepas mengalami pembulian yang teruk dan mendapat inspirasi.’ Paula Abbandonato, Pengarah Kebangsaan Miss Universe GB, berkata: ‘Lauren telah menjadi sebahagian yang hebat dalam barisan tahun ini. ‘Dia seorang yang unik dan kami sangat gembira dapat melibatkan dia. ‘Usaha yang dilakukannya untuk meningkatkan kesedaran tentang penghidap Asperger adalah sesuatu yang sangat baik. ‘Dia menggalakkan gadis-gadis lain untuk tidak membiarkan rasa tidak selamat atau keadaan mereka menentukan siapa diri mereka. Dia adalah inspirasi yang sebenar.’

article_content: Kabul, Afghanistan (CNN) -- The bodies of three American contractors who died in a plane crash in Afghanistan earlier this month have been recovered, NATO's International Security Assistance Force said Tuesday. The C-12 plane went down in the mountains of Nuristan province on October 13, but the military withheld information about it until the recovery operation was complete, ISAF said in a statement. The crew members were subcontractors working for Lockheed Martin, the company confirmed. A spokesman named two of the victims as Jeff Lehner, a former Air Force member working for Sierra Nevada, and Randolph Bergquist, a former Marine working for Avenge. The third name is not being released at the family's request. Thomas Casey of Lockheed Martin confirmed the third victim was the co-pilot and also worked for Avenge. The cause of the crash that killed them is not yet clear, but it is not thought to be enemy action, ISAF said. A helicopter sent to recover the remains on October 17 experienced a 'hard landing' that required the crew to be rescued, ISAF said. The helicopter was stripped of sensitive parts on Wednesday and destroyed in place on Sunday, ISAF said.

Pesawat C-12 terhempas di pergunungan wilayah Nuristan pada 13 Oktober, tetapi pihak tentera menahan maklumat mengenainya sehingga operasi pemulihan selesai, kata ISAF dalam satu kenyataan. Anggota kru adalah subkontraktor yang bekerja untuk Lockheed Martin, syarikat itu mengesahkan. Seorang jurucakap menamakan dua daripada mangsa sebagai Jeff Lehner, bekas anggota Tentera Udara yang bekerja untuk Sierra Nevada, dan Randolph Bergquist, bekas Marin yang bekerja untuk Avenge. Nama ketiga tidak dikeluarkan atas permintaan keluarga. Thomas Casey dari Lockheed Martin mengesahkan mangsa ketiga adalah pembantu juruterbang dan juga bekerja untuk Avenge. Punca nahas yang menyebabkan kematian mereka masih belum jelas, tetapi ia tidak dianggap sebagai tindakan musuh, kata ISAF. Sebuah helikopter yang dihantar untuk mendapatkan semula mayat pada 17 Oktober mengalami 'pendaratan keras' yang memerlukan kru diselamatkan, kata ISAF. Helikopter itu dilucutkan bahagian-bahagian sensitif pada hari Rabu dan dimusnahkan di lokasi pada hari Ahad, kata ISAF.

article_content: A major Colombian drug trafficker has been handed a 22-year prison sentence in the United States after admitting to his role in a large-scale cocaine smuggling operation. The Justice Department announced on Thursday that Edgar Vallejo Guarin, aged 50, received his sentence from U.S. District Judge Patricia Seitz on Wednesday. In addition to the lengthy prison term, Vallejo was also ordered to pay a fine of $1 million. Authorities have also seized a plane valued at more than $2 million and have successfully forfeited over $10 million held in various accounts worldwide, believed to be profits from his drug trafficking activities. Vallejo confessed in court documents that he managed a sophisticated drug network responsible for shipping thousands of kilograms of cocaine from Colombia to the United States. The illicit drugs were transported via boats, cargo ships, and aircraft, reaching cities such as Houston, San Juan, and New York. Vallejo also oversaw criminal groups in Detroit and Chicago as part of his extensive operation. Although Vallejo was initially charged in 2001, he evaded capture for several years, remaining a fugitive until his arrest in Spain in 2008. He was subsequently extradited to the United States in 2010 to face charges. The successful prosecution of Vallejo was the result of a collaborative investigation involving the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), and the Colombian National Police.

Selain hukuman penjara yang panjang, Vallejo juga diperintahkan untuk membayar denda sebanyak $1 juta. Pihak berkuasa juga telah merampas sebuah pesawat yang bernilai lebih daripada $2 juta dan telah berjaya menyita lebih $10 juta yang disimpan dalam pelbagai akaun di seluruh dunia, yang dipercayai sebagai keuntungan daripada aktiviti pengedaran dadahnya. article_content: Police officers in New York City have been found to be uploading pictures of themselves in their official uniforms on various dating websites. This action goes against the rules set by the NYPD. Despite the regulations, it appears that some officers are using their uniforms to impress people they might want to date. They have been seen posing in uniform with police vehicles like patrol cars and motorcycles. One officer, aged 29, who uses the online name 'SandyManPete', included a picture of himself with his motorcycle. In his profile, he mentioned that he enjoys rock music, snacks, and 'women who respect themselves'. According to a statement given to MailOnline by NYPD Deputy Commissioner John J. McCarthy, police officers are not allowed to post photos of themselves in uniform unless they have permission beforehand. This rule does not apply to photos taken at official police events. The policy is in place to follow New York City's Social Media Policy and is partly designed to keep officers safe by preventing them from sharing personal details online that could put them at risk. Deputy Commissioner McCarthy also stated that officers who break this rule could face disciplinary actions. Another officer, known as 'OfficerHassan' and aged 28, indicated in his profile that he is interested in 'drama-free' women. It's not just NYPD officers who are trying to attract partners by highlighting their jobs. Dating profiles of firefighters and members of the U.S. Marines have also been seen featuring pictures of them in uniform while on duty. For example, one 33-year-old firefighter from the Bronx posted a picture on Match.com of himself in front of a fire truck, wearing safety gear. Another profile on OkCupid showed a 23-year-old U.S. Marine in uniform, stating that 'music is passion in the form of sound'. Another individual, aged 25 from West Hempstead, NY, shared pictures in uniform and of military helicopters on his dating profile. MailOnline has contacted the New York City Fire Department and the U.S. Marine Corps for their comments and is waiting for a response. These instances show that alongside NYPD officers, members of the U.S. Marines have also been found on dating sites using their uniforms in their profiles.

article_content: More and more wedding attendees are now incorporating their remote jobs into wedding celebrations, turning them into extended work-and-celebrate events. For instance, when Anna Sullivan, a 25-year-old digital marketer, and Taylor Brandenberger, a 26-year-old home inspector, got married in East Lansing, Michigan, last month, ten of Anna's friends arrived several days early. They rented an Airbnb to work remotely during the day and then socialize in the evenings, effectively extending their wedding celebration without using vacation days.  Many guests even stayed until Monday, working a full day before heading to the airport. Anna Brandenberger mentioned that having this extra time was incredibly precious, allowing for more relaxed and extended interactions with loved ones beyond just the wedding day itself.  The rise of remote work since the pandemic has significantly changed workplace norms and employee lifestyles.  Initially a necessity, remote work has become a preferred option for many, with hybrid and fully remote schedules becoming common.  Research from the Pew Research Center indicates that about a third of American workers have some form of remote work option.  Wedding guests with this flexibility are increasingly taking advantage of it to prolong their stay at wedding locations. Hotels, wedding planners, and couples are noticing this shift and adapting accordingly. Anna Brandenberger's mother, who works remotely in billing for a Chicago trading firm and lives four hours away, arrived a week before the wedding. She worked during the day and joined in wedding preparations like flower arranging and baking in the evenings, which Anna found to be a significant help and stress reliever. The possibility of working remotely can even influence wedding attendance.  The Brandenbergers chose a Friday night wedding to reduce venue rental costs, but this meant some out-of-town guests unable to take a day off from their physical workplaces couldn't attend. Destination weddings, already popular with hotels and resorts, are now further boosted by this trend.  Many venues had previously upgraded their Wi-Fi and added workspaces for remote workers during the pandemic. Now, these two trends are merging. Camptown, a 50-room hotel in Leeds, New York, reports longer wedding-related stays. Stephen Wendell, CEO of Mountain Shore Properties, notes that guests are extending their bookings after realizing they can work from the hotel, which offers high-speed internet, workspaces, and a self-service pantry.  Currently, around 20% of wedding guests at Camptown arrive mid-week, with Wednesdays being the most popular day for early arrivals.   Similarly, The Kimpton Armory in Bozeman, Montana, has seen an increase in midweek wedding guest arrivals. Courtney Reeves, sales and marketing director, says they've enhanced their free Wi-Fi, expanded rooftop coverage, added free printing, and opened meeting rooms for daytime laptop use. Michael Bruno, owner of Valley Rock Inn in Sloatsburg, New York, states that extended wedding stays have increased since the pandemic, with about 25% lasting two to three days beyond the weekend. Guests at Valley Rock Inn can enjoy activities like guided hikes and yoga, with remote work facilities including high-speed internet throughout the property and well-equipped meeting rooms. Camptown's Wendell mentions that while the trend of extended stays grew organically, they are now actively marketing their remote work amenities for the 2024 wedding season, highlighting these features to potential clients to fill midweek room bookings.  An unexpectedly large number of early-arriving remote workers can sometimes lead to last-minute adjustments. Ben Cole and Max Alderman, who married in Portland, Oregon, last summer, were surprised when half of their 100 guests arrived days before their Sunday wedding to work remotely. They had to quickly expand their planned pre-wedding activities to accommodate the larger group.
translated_content: Semakin ramai tetamu perkahwinan kini menggabungkan pekerjaan jarak jauh mereka ke dalam perayaan perkahwinan, mengubahnya menjadi acara kerja-dan-meraikan yang lebih panjang. Contohnya, apabila Anna Sullivan, seorang pemasar digital berusia 25 tahun, dan Taylor Brandenberger, seorang pemeriksa rumah berusia 26 tahun, berkahwin di East Lansing, Michigan, bulan lepas, sepuluh orang rakan Anna tiba beberapa hari lebih awal. Mereka menyewa Airbnb untuk bekerja dari jauh pada siang hari dan kemudian bersosial pada waktu malam, dengan berkesan memanjangkan perayaan perkahwinan mereka tanpa menggunakan cuti. Ramai tetamu malah tinggal sehingga hari Isnin, bekerja sehari penuh sebelum menuju ke lapangan terbang. Anna Brandenberger menyebut bahawa masa tambahan ini sangat berharga, membolehkan interaksi yang lebih santai dan panjang dengan orang tersayang di luar hari perkahwinan itu sendiri. Kebangkitan kerja jarak jauh sejak pandemik telah mengubah norma tempat kerja dan gaya hidup pekerja dengan ketara. Pada mulanya satu keperluan, kerja jarak jauh telah menjadi pilihan yang digemari bagi ramai, dengan jadual hibrid dan sepenuhnya jarak jauh menjadi perkara biasa. Penyelidikan dari Pusat Penyelidikan Pew menunjukkan bahawa kira-kira satu pertiga pekerja Amerika mempunyai beberapa bentuk pilihan kerja jarak jauh. Tetamu perkahwinan dengan fleksibiliti ini semakin memanfaatkannya untuk memanjangkan penginapan mereka di lokasi perkahwinan. Hotel, perancang perkahwinan, dan pasangan menyedari perubahan ini dan menyesuaikan diri sewajarnya. Ibu Anna Brandenberger, yang bekerja dari jauh dalam bidang bil untuk firma dagangan di Chicago dan tinggal empat jam jauhnya, tiba seminggu sebelum perkahwinan. Dia bekerja pada siang hari dan menyertai persiapan perkahwinan seperti menyusun bunga dan membakar kuih pada waktu malam, yang Anna dapati sangat membantu dan melegakan tekanan. Kemungkinan bekerja dari jauh malah boleh mempengaruhi kehadiran perkahwinan. Keluarga Brandenberger memilih perkahwinan malam Jumaat untuk mengurangkan kos sewa tempat, tetapi ini bermakna sesetengah tetamu dari luar bandar yang tidak dapat mengambil cuti dari tempat kerja fizikal mereka tidak dapat hadir. Perkahwinan destinasi, yang sudah popular dengan hotel dan pusat peranginan, kini dipertingkatkan lagi oleh trend ini. Banyak tempat telah menaik taraf Wi-Fi mereka dan menambah ruang kerja untuk pekerja jarak jauh semasa pandemik. Kini, kedua-dua trend ini bergabung. Camptown, sebuah hotel 50 bilik di Leeds, New York, melaporkan penginapan berkaitan perkahwinan yang lebih lama. Stephen Wendell, CEO Mountain Shore Properties, menyatakan bahawa tetamu melanjutkan tempahan mereka selepas menyedari mereka boleh bekerja dari hotel, yang menawarkan internet berkelajuan tinggi, ruang kerja, dan pantri layan diri. Pada masa ini, kira-kira 20% tetamu perkahwinan di Camptown tiba pada pertengahan minggu, dengan hari Rabu menjadi hari paling popular untuk ketibaan awal. Begitu juga, The Kimpton Armory di Bozeman, Montana, telah melihat peningkatan dalam ketibaan tetamu perkahwinan pertengahan minggu. Courtney Reeves, pengarah jualan dan pemasaran, mengatakan mereka telah meningkatkan Wi-Fi percuma, memperluas liputan atas bumbung, menambah perkhidmatan percetakan percuma, dan membuka bilik mesyuarat untuk penggunaan komputer riba pada siang hari. Michael Bruno, pemilik Valley Rock Inn di Sloatsburg, New York, menyatakan bahawa penginapan perkahwinan yang panjang telah meningkat sejak pandemik, dengan kira-kira 25% berlangsung dua hingga tiga hari melebihi hujung minggu. Tetamu di Valley Rock Inn boleh menikmati aktiviti seperti mendaki berpandu dan yoga, dengan kemudahan kerja jarak jauh termasuk internet berkelajuan tinggi di seluruh kawasan hotel dan bilik mesyuarat yang serba lengkap. Wendell dari Camptown menyebut bahawa walaupun trend penginapan yang panjang berkembang secara organik, mereka kini secara aktif memasarkan kemudahan kerja jarak jauh mereka untuk musim perkahwinan 2024, menyoroti ciri-ciri ini kepada bakal pelanggan untuk mengisi tempahan bilik pertengahan minggu. Sebilangan besar pekerja jarak jauh yang tiba awal secara tidak dijangka kadangkala boleh menyebabkan pelarasan saat akhir. Ben Cole dan Max Alderman, yang berkahwin di Portland, Oregon, musim panas lalu, terkejut apabila separuh daripada 100 tetamu mereka tiba beberapa hari sebelum perkahwinan Ahad mereka untuk bekerja dari jauh. Mereka terpaksa dengan cepat mengembangkan aktiviti pra-perkahwinan yang dirancang untuk menampung kumpulan yang lebih besar.

article_content: Imagine a world without the hassle of remembering countless passwords for your devices, accounts, and even physical keys. A Canadian technology firm, Bionym, is pioneering a solution with its Nymi bracelet. This innovative wearable aims to replace traditional authentication methods by using your unique heartbeat. The Nymi bracelet works by monitoring your cardiac rhythm, which, similar to a fingerprint, is distinct to each individual. This cardiac rhythm is detected via an electrocardiogram (ECG). When you wear the Nymi and touch its sensors, it verifies your identity based on your heartbeat. Once authenticated, the bracelet can wirelessly communicate with paired devices like computers, smartphones, and cars to automatically unlock them as you approach. Bionym highlights that Nymi employs a robust 3-factor security system. This includes the physical bracelet itself, your unique heartbeat, and a registered Authorized Authentication Device (AAD), typically your smartphone. To activate the bracelet, you simply clasp it on your wrist and place a finger on the sensor to complete the circuit and authenticate your heartbeat. According to Bionym's founder, Dr. Karl Martin, this method is even more secure than other biometric options like iris or facial recognition. He argues that physical features like faces and irises can be more easily copied or stolen, whereas your heartbeat is an internal, dynamic biometric identifier. Beyond unlocking devices, Nymi offers additional functionalities. It includes a motion sensor for gesture control, allowing users to perform actions like opening car trunks or controlling smart TV applications with wrist movements. Furthermore, Nymi can facilitate secure wireless payments, potentially replacing credit cards and wallets. While the initial Nymi product is a bracelet, Bionym suggests that the technology could be integrated into other forms of accessories like rings or belts in the future. The Nymi bracelet is available for pre-order at a discounted price for early customers, with shipping anticipated in early 2014. It promises a future where security is seamless and convenient, all controlled by your heartbeat.
translated_content: Bayangkan dunia tanpa kerumitan mengingati kata laluan yang tak terhitung banyaknya untuk peranti, akaun, dan juga kunci fizikal anda. Sebuah firma teknologi Kanada, Bionym, sedang mempelopori penyelesaian dengan gelang Nymi mereka. Peranti boleh pakai yang inovatif ini bertujuan untuk menggantikan kaedah pengesahan tradisional dengan menggunakan degupan jantung unik anda. Gelang Nymi berfungsi dengan memantau ritma jantung anda, yang, sama seperti cap jari, berbeza bagi setiap individu. Ritma jantung ini dikesan melalui elektrokardiogram (ECG). Apabila anda memakai Nymi dan menyentuh sensornya, ia mengesahkan identiti anda berdasarkan degupan jantung anda. Setelah disahkan, gelang ini boleh berkomunikasi secara tanpa wayar dengan peranti yang dipasangkan seperti komputer, telefon pintar dan kereta untuk membukanya secara automatik apabila anda menghampiri. Bionym menekankan bahawa Nymi menggunakan sistem keselamatan 3 faktor yang kukuh. Ini termasuk gelang fizikal itu sendiri, degupan jantung unik anda, dan Peranti Pengesahan Sah (AAD) yang berdaftar, biasanya telefon pintar anda. Untuk mengaktifkan gelang itu, anda hanya perlu memasangkannya di pergelangan tangan anda dan meletakkan jari pada sensor untuk melengkapkan litar dan mengesahkan degupan jantung anda. Menurut pengasas Bionym, Dr. Karl Martin, kaedah ini malah lebih selamat daripada pilihan biometrik lain seperti pengecaman iris atau wajah. Beliau berhujah bahawa ciri-ciri fizikal seperti wajah dan iris lebih mudah disalin atau dicuri, sedangkan degupan jantung anda adalah pengecam biometrik dalaman dan dinamik. Selain membuka kunci peranti, Nymi menawarkan fungsi tambahan. Ia termasuk sensor gerakan untuk kawalan isyarat, yang membolehkan pengguna melakukan tindakan seperti membuka bonet kereta atau mengawal aplikasi TV pintar dengan pergerakan pergelangan tangan. Tambahan pula, Nymi boleh memudahkan pembayaran tanpa wayar yang selamat, berpotensi menggantikan kad kredit dan dompet. Walaupun produk Nymi awal adalah gelang, Bionym mencadangkan bahawa teknologi itu boleh disepadukan ke dalam bentuk aksesori lain seperti cincin atau tali pinggang pada masa hadapan. Gelang Nymi boleh dipra-tempah pada harga diskaun untuk pelanggan awal, dengan penghantaran dijangka pada awal tahun 2014. Ia menjanjikan masa depan di mana keselamatan adalah lancar dan mudah, semuanya dikawal oleh degupan jantung anda.

article_content: By Michael Zennie. PUBLISHED: 11:07 EST, 4 November 2013 | UPDATED: 13:23 EST, 4 November 2013 A New York City jail guard who was impregnated by a convicted cop killer has lost custody of her young son after it was revealed she got drunk with the murderer's family twice after he was sentenced to death. Nancy Gonzalez's attorney says the family of Ronell Wilson was manipulating her and blamed her for a jury condemning him to the death penalty. Wilson was convicted of capital murder for shooting dead two undercover NYPD detectives during a 2003 gun bust. In hot water again: Nancy Gonzalez, center, had custody of her son revoked after a judge learned she got drunk with convict killer Ronell Wilson's family. Ploy: Prosecutors say Wilson got Gonzalez pregnant so that he could use the baby as a reason not to be executed. The New York Daily News reports that a judge revoked Gonzalez's parental rights after learning about the two meetings she had with Wilson's family over the summer. The baby, conceived in an 'activity room' at Brooklyn's Metropolitan Detention Center while Gonzalez was working there, is named 'Justus' and is now five months old. He was placed in foster care with Gonzalez's maternal aunt. A family court judge found that Gonzalez's behavior was neglectful because Gonzalez, a recovering drug addict, was not allowed to use alcohol while free on bail. She is awaiting sentencing on charges of having sex with an inmate. Anthony Ricco, the lawyer for the 29-year-old corrections officer, says his client was being manipulated by Wilson's family. Gonzalez's pregnancy threw a wrench in the death penalty case against Wilson - though she ultimately refused to take the stand and testify on his behalf. The baby, Justus, was conceived in an 'activity room' at the Metropolitan Detention Center in Sunset Park, Brooklyn. They were 'subtly blaming her' for Wilson being sentenced to death by a federal jury this summer. Gonzalez, 29, refused to testify at his sentencing hearing. Prosecutors said they suspected Wilson targeted Gonzalez and impregnated her so that he could use his child as an argument not to sentence him to the death penalty. In court filings, Mr Ricco described his client as mentally unstable and vulnerable. He claimed that she had been sexually abused and raped by her step-father, her uncles and other men. As an example of her emotional instability, Mr Ricco said that his client had sexual relations with eight other guards - some men, some women - during her two years working at Metropolitan Detention Center. She is set to be sentenced November 15 on charges of having sex with an inmate. She faces 15 years in prison, though Mr Ricco urged a judge to give her probation so she can continue getting psychological treatment.

article_content: Winter is approaching in the Swiss Alps, marked by the traditional descent of flower-decorated cows to lower pastures.  As Switzerland commemorates 150 years of winter sports tourism, the industry is facing change. New Swiss laws mandating minimum wage for staff in ski chalets, especially those run by British companies, have significantly impacted budget ski holidays.  Many UK operators, finding the increased costs unsustainable, have withdrawn from the Swiss market.  While luxury chalets remain, they are expensive, averaging around £2,000 per person weekly, excluding travel. However, despite these shifts, affordable ski holiday options still exist.  Even in top Swiss hotels, deals can be found, such as the five-star Tschuggen Grand Hotel in Arosa offering a three-night half-board stay from £621 per person in late November, including spa access and exclusive slope use.  For those looking beyond Switzerland, Ischgl in Austria is kicking off the season with a concert by James Blunt in late November. Packages including accommodation, ski pass, and concert entry start from £230 per person.  In the French Alps, Megeve is preparing for a new branch of Folie Douce, known for lively après-ski.  For family-friendly options, driving to the Alps is becoming more popular, with ferry companies offering competitive rates.  Further afield, Sun Peaks in Canada is gaining recognition as a growing ski destination, while Vail in Colorado is set to host the Alpine World Ski Championships.  Deals are available in these locations, including packages to Sun Peaks and Vail from ski holiday specialists.  Despite changes in the Swiss ski market, numerous winter holiday opportunities remain across Europe and North America, catering to various budgets and preferences.

Walaupun chalet mewah masih kekal, harganya sangat mahal, secara purata sekitar £2,000 seorang setiap minggu, tidak termasuk kos perjalanan. Walau bagaimanapun, di sebalik perubahan ini, pilihan percutian ski yang berpatutan masih lagi wujud. Malah di hotel-hotel mewah Switzerland, tawaran menarik masih boleh didapati, seperti Hotel Grand Tschuggen bintang lima di Arosa yang menawarkan pakej penginapan tiga malam separuh lembaga bermula dari £621 seorang pada akhir bulan November, termasuk akses spa dan penggunaan cerun ski eksklusif. Bagi mereka yang mencari destinasi di luar Switzerland, Ischgl di Austria akan memulakan musim ini dengan konsert oleh James Blunt pada penghujung November. Pakej-pakej percutian termasuk penginapan, pas ski, dan tiket konsert bermula dari £230 seorang. Di Banjaran Alps Perancis, Megeve sedang bersedia untuk pembukaan cawangan baru Folie Douce, yang terkenal dengan suasana après-ski yang meriah. Untuk pilihan percutian yang mesra keluarga, memandu ke Alps menjadi semakin popular, dengan syarikat-syarikat feri menawarkan harga yang kompetitif.
