article_content: Disgraced DJ Dave Lee Travis, convicted of a sex offense, avoided jail time but remained unrepentant, stating that a £1 million investigation had failed to prove he was a ‘sexual predator’. The 69-year-old showed no remorse, expressing he was ‘mortified and disappointed’ by his conviction for molesting a young researcher at the BBC, but ignored calls to apologize to his victim. In a defiant statement outside Southwark Crown Court, Travis, who previously described the case as a celebrity witch-hunt, suggested his guilty verdict was the result of prosecutorial overreach. He argued that ‘millions of pounds of taxpayers’ money’ and extensive police resources were spent, yet the judge acknowledged the prosecution had not proven he was a ‘sexual predator’. Travis, accompanied by his wife Marianne, received a three-month suspended prison sentence for two years after being found guilty of groping a researcher in her 20s on the set of the Mrs Merton Show. The groping involved Travis touching the researcher’s breasts for 10-15 seconds after seeing her smoking and commenting on her ‘poor little lungs’. Travis claimed he had always feared ‘if the prosecution threw enough mud at me, some of it might stick’, expressing relief at not being labeled a sexual predator but ‘mortified’ by the single conviction, finding little comfort in acquittals on other charges. Judge Anthony Leonard, QC, stated Travis had exploited his status as a ‘well-known media personality’ to molest the 22-year-old researcher, believing ‘she would not make a fuss’. The victim, now a successful TV personality, described the assault as ‘an unprovoked and terrifying physical assault at my place of work’ that left her ‘paralysed with fear’. Throughout the trial, Travis maintained his innocence and dismissed other accusers as ‘fantasists and liars’. The researcher found claims she sought fame or financial gain particularly hurtful, stating outside court that she was ‘mortified’ and ‘disappointed’ by the guilty verdict. She added that her wife Marianne and close ones knew ‘the truth’, for which she was grateful, and criticized the ‘millions’ spent on his prosecution. Judge Leonard noted Travis had used his celebrity status and large physical presence to intimidate his victim. In her victim impact statement, the researcher described the assault as ‘unprovoked and terrifying’, leaving her ‘paralysed with fear’ and feeling like a ‘scared, vulnerable young woman’ even years later. She expressed gratitude that the jury believed her and emphasized she sought only to ‘tell the truth’, not financial compensation or fame. The judge recounted the assault, detailing how Travis, ‘towering’ over her, pinned her against a wall, groped her breasts, and left her feeling ‘violated’ and ‘beside herself’. The BBC potentially faces lawsuits from women claiming Travis assaulted them during his 30-year career. Civil lawsuits, including one from a woman claiming assault in the 1970s as a ‘pre-teen’, are also possible. Travis, tried under his real name David Griffin, had previously been acquitted of 12 indecent assaults dating back to the 1970s. The first jury was undecided on some charges, leading to a retrial where he was convicted of the 1995 assault but acquitted on another charge, with a hung jury on a third, resulting in a not guilty verdict. Travis was not required to register as a sex offender because the assault occurred before the register’s implementation. He was arrested in October 2012 under Operation Yewtree, Scotland Yard’s investigation into historic sexual abuse triggered by the Jimmy Savile scandal. Judge Leonard considered Travis’s offense ‘different’ from other Operation Yewtree convictions. Operation Yewtree, costing £3 million, faced early criticism after acquittals in cases against William Roache and Michael Le Vell, but later secured convictions against Max Clifford and Rolf Harris. Max Clifford received an eight-year sentence for indecent assault, and Rolf Harris received a five-year sentence for similar offenses. Operation Yewtree investigated 17 people, resulting in three convictions, including Travis, Clifford, and Harris. Eight individuals, including Jim Davidson and Freddie Starr, faced no further action, while others like Paul Gambaccini remained on bail, and some, like Gary Glitter and Chris Denning, faced prosecution. Driver David Smith was also due to face trial but died before it commenced. Operation Yewtree was initiated following revelations about Jimmy Savile’s extensive sexual abuse.

Lelaki berusia 69 tahun itu tidak menunjukkan rasa kesal, dan menyatakan bahawa dia ‘terasa malu dan kecewa’ dengan sabitan atas kesalahan mencabul seorang penyelidik muda di BBC, tetapi mengabaikan seruan untuk meminta maaf kepada mangsanya. Dalam kenyataan yang mencabar di luar Mahkamah Crown Southwark, Travis, yang sebelum ini menyifatkan kes itu sebagai pemburuan ahli sihir selebriti, mencadangkan sabitan bersalahnya adalah akibat daripada tindakan pendakwaan yang berlebihan. Dia berhujah bahawa ‘berjuta-juta pound wang pembayar cukai’ dan sumber polis yang besar telah dibelanjakan, namun hakim mengakui bahawa pendakwa raya tidak membuktikan dia seorang ‘pemangsa seksual’. Travis, diiringi oleh isterinya Marianne, menerima hukuman penjara tiga bulan yang ditangguhkan selama dua tahun selepas didapati bersalah meraba seorang penyelidik berusia 20-an di set rancangan Mrs Merton Show. Perbuatan meraba itu melibatkan Travis menyentuh payudara penyelidik itu selama 10-15 saat selepas melihatnya merokok dan mengulas tentang ‘paru-parunya yang kecil dan malang’. Travis mendakwa dia sentiasa bimbang ‘jika pihak pendakwa raya melemparkan lumpur yang cukup ke arah saya, sebahagian daripadanya mungkin melekat’, dan melahirkan rasa lega kerana tidak dilabel sebagai pemangsa seksual tetapi ‘terasa malu’ dengan satu sabitan, serta tidak berasa selesa dengan pembebasan atas pertuduhan lain. Hakim Anthony Leonard, QC, menyatakan bahawa Travis telah mengeksploitasi statusnya sebagai ‘personaliti media terkenal’ untuk mencabul penyelidik berusia 22 tahun itu, kerana mempercayai ‘dia tidak akan membuat kecoh’. Mangsa, yang kini merupakan personaliti TV yang berjaya, menyifatkan serangan itu sebagai ‘serangan fizikal yang tidak diprovokasi dan menakutkan di tempat kerja saya’ yang menyebabkan dia ‘lumpuh ketakutan’. Sepanjang perbicaraan, Travis mengekalkan pengakuannya tidak bersalah dan menolak penuduh lain sebagai ‘pembohong dan pembuat cerita khayalan’. Penyelidik itu mendapati dakwaan bahawa dia mencari kemasyhuran atau keuntungan kewangan sangat menyakitkan hati, dan menyatakan di luar mahkamah bahawa dia ‘terasa malu’ dan ‘kecewa’ dengan sabitan bersalah itu. Dia menambah bahawa isterinya Marianne dan orang-orang terdekatnya mengetahui ‘kebenaran’, yang mana dia bersyukur, dan mengkritik ‘berjuta-juta’ yang dibelanjakan untuk pendakwaannya. Hakim Leonard menyatakan bahawa Travis telah menggunakan status selebritinya dan saiz fizikalnya yang besar untuk menakutkan mangsanya. Dalam kenyataan kesan mangsanya, penyelidik itu menyifatkan serangan itu sebagai ‘tidak diprovokasi dan menakutkan’, yang menyebabkan dia ‘lumpuh ketakutan’ dan berasa seperti ‘wanita muda yang takut dan lemah’ walaupun bertahun-tahun kemudian. Dia melahirkan rasa syukur kerana juri mempercayainya dan menegaskan bahawa dia hanya mahu ‘menceritakan kebenaran’, dan bukan pampasan kewangan atau kemasyhuran. Hakim menceritakan semula serangan itu, dan memperincikan bagaimana Travis, yang ‘menjulang’ di atasnya, menolaknya ke dinding, meraba payudaranya, dan membuatnya berasa ‘dicabul’ dan ‘tidak keruan’. BBC berpotensi menghadapi tindakan undang-undang daripada wanita yang mendakwa bahawa Travis menyerang mereka semasa kerjayanya selama 30 tahun. Tindakan undang-undang sivil, termasuk satu daripada seorang wanita yang mendakwa serangan pada tahun 1970-an ketika masih ‘pra-remaja’, juga mungkin berlaku. Travis, yang dibicarakan dengan nama sebenarnya David Griffin, sebelum ini telah dibebaskan daripada 12 pertuduhan serangan tidak senonoh yang bermula sejak tahun 1970-an. Juri pertama tidak membuat keputusan mengenai beberapa pertuduhan, yang membawa kepada perbicaraan semula di mana dia disabitkan kesalahan serangan tahun 1995 tetapi dibebaskan atas pertuduhan lain, dengan juri tergantung pada pertuduhan ketiga, yang mengakibatkan keputusan tidak bersalah. Travis tidak diwajibkan mendaftar sebagai pesalah seks kerana serangan itu berlaku sebelum daftar itu dilaksanakan. Dia ditangkap pada Oktober 2012 di bawah Operasi Yewtree, iaitu siasatan Scotland Yard terhadap penderaan seksual bersejarah yang dicetuskan oleh skandal Jimmy Savile. Hakim Leonard menganggap kesalahan Travis ‘berbeza’ daripada sabitan Operasi Yewtree yang lain. Operasi Yewtree, yang menelan kos £3 juta, menghadapi kritikan awal selepas pembebasan dalam kes terhadap William Roache dan Michael Le Vell, tetapi kemudian memperoleh sabitan terhadap Max Clifford dan Rolf Harris. Max Clifford menerima hukuman lapan tahun penjara kerana serangan tidak senonoh, dan Rolf Harris menerima hukuman penjara lima tahun untuk kesalahan yang serupa. Operasi Yewtree menyiasat 17 orang, dan menghasilkan tiga sabitan, termasuk Travis, Clifford, dan Harris. Lapan individu, termasuk Jim Davidson dan Freddie Starr, tidak menghadapi tindakan lanjut, manakala yang lain seperti Paul Gambaccini kekal diikat jamin polis, dan beberapa orang, seperti Gary Glitter dan Chris Denning, menghadapi pendakwaan. Pemandu David Smith juga sepatutnya menghadapi perbicaraan tetapi meninggal dunia sebelum ia sempat dimulakan. Operasi Yewtree dimulakan berikutan pendedahan tentang penderaan seksual besar-besaran oleh Jimmy Savile.

article_content: Neymar, the Brazilian football star, is on track to play again for Barcelona around August 18. His recovery from a significant back injury, sustained during the World Cup, is progressing well. The injury, a fractured vertebra, happened when Colombia's Juan Zuniga challenged him in their World Cup quarter-final game, forcing Neymar to miss the rest of the tournament. Neymar is now aiming to make his comeback in the Gamper Trophy match against Leon from Mexico on August 18. If this happens, he'll be back in action a week before Barcelona starts their La Liga season against Elche. While in Japan for a promotional event, Neymar mentioned that he's gradually getting better and expects to be fully fit when he rejoins Barcelona in early August. He stated his goal is to have a successful season and contribute to his team's achievements. Neymar, aged 22, is scheduled to return to Barcelona on August 5. Barcelona had a disappointing previous season, failing to win any major trophies for the first time in six years. Consequently, their coach Gerardo Martino was replaced by Luis Enrique, a former Barcelona player.

article_content: Italian motorsport team Ferrari is determined to regain its top form in Barcelona next month after team errors caused their lead driver, Fernando Alonso, to lose ground in the Formula One title race. Two mistakes led to Alonso dropping to fourth place in the driver standings, now 30 points behind Red Bull's champion Sebastian Vettel.  His Bahrain race was hampered by issues with his car's rear-wing overtaking system. The Spanish driver also crashed out of the Malaysian Grand Prix when the team failed to bring him into the pits to fix a damaged front wing, which had dangerously slipped under his car. These errors have placed Ferrari, without a team title since 2008, in third in the constructor standings, trailing Red Bull and Lotus. Following the initial four races of the 2013 season, the team has returned to their Maranello base in northern Italy. Team principal Stefano Domenicali has urged the renowned racing team to rally. "We must achieve perfection in every aspect," Domenicali stated. "Reliability is key, from the smallest to largest part.  This level of perfection must be Ferrari's standard. We need to refocus our attention on this area." This increased focus is already evident at the Ferrari factory. Engineers resolved the issue with Alonso's faulty drag reduction system (DRS) – an overtaking aid that boosts speed by opening the rear wing flap – the day after the Bahrain Grand Prix. Analysis showed a broken mechanical component caused the problem. Ferrari stated this was a first in the three years DRS has been used in F1. However, the team acknowledges ongoing work is needed, especially after Brazilian driver Felipe Massa also had a difficult race in Bahrain, finishing 15th due to tire problems. Alonso began the race third but finished eighth after two pit stops to repair his faulty rear wing. "It's rare to see so many issues in one race," Domenicali commented. "The DRS failure prevented Fernando, who again performed excellently, from competing with Vettel for victory." "For Felipe, two tire issues prevented him from achieving a top-five finish.  He was capable of this." "In these first four races, we haven't secured the points we could have, due to various factors. This explains the considerable gap in the standings." Strong performances in Australia and China, where Alonso secured a dominant Ferrari victory, give the team hope. They believe they can still challenge Red Bull, Lotus, and Mercedes for the title when racing resumes in Barcelona on May 12. "We are confident in our ability to contend for the titles until the end.  This year, we've been in the fight from the start, which is a change," Domenicali said. "We shouldn't be discouraged. History shows us how quickly fortunes can change, both for and against us."
translated_content: Pasukan permotoran Itali Ferrari berazam untuk kembali ke prestasi terbaik mereka di Barcelona bulan depan selepas kesilapan pasukan menyebabkan pemandu utama mereka, Fernando Alonso, kehilangan kedudukan dalam perlumbaan kejuaraan Formula Satu. Dua kesilapan menyebabkan Alonso jatuh ke tempat keempat dalam kedudukan pemandu, kini 30 mata di belakang juara Red Bull, Sebastian Vettel. Perlumbaan beliau di Bahrain terjejas oleh masalah dengan sistem memotong sayap belakang keretanya. Pemandu Sepanyol itu juga terkeluar dari Grand Prix Malaysia apabila pasukan gagal membawanya masuk ke pit untuk membaiki sayap depan yang rosak, yang telah tergelincir di bawah keretanya dengan bahaya. Kesilapan-kesilapan ini telah meletakkan Ferrari, yang tidak memenangi gelaran pasukan sejak 2008, di tempat ketiga dalam kedudukan pengeluar, di belakang Red Bull dan Lotus. Selepas empat perlumbaan pertama musim 2013, pasukan itu telah kembali ke pangkalan Maranello mereka di utara Itali. Prinsipal pasukan Stefano Domenicali telah menggesa pasukan perlumbaan terkenal itu untuk bangkit semula. "Kita mesti mencapai kesempurnaan dalam setiap aspek," kata Domenicali. "Kebolehpercayaan adalah kunci, dari komponen terkecil hingga terbesar. Tahap kesempurnaan ini mestilah standard Ferrari. Kita perlu memfokuskan semula perhatian kita pada bidang ini." Peningkatan fokus ini sudah pun jelas di kilang Ferrari. Jurutera telah menyelesaikan masalah dengan sistem pengurangan seretan (DRS) Alonso yang rosak – alat bantuan memotong yang meningkatkan kelajuan dengan membuka flap sayap belakang – sehari selepas Grand Prix Bahrain. Analisis menunjukkan komponen mekanikal yang rosak menyebabkan masalah itu. Ferrari menyatakan ini adalah yang pertama dalam tiga tahun DRS telah digunakan dalam F1. Walau bagaimanapun, pasukan mengakui kerja yang berterusan diperlukan, terutamanya selepas pemandu Brazil Felipe Massa juga mengalami perlumbaan yang sukar di Bahrain, menamatkan perlumbaan di tempat ke-15 kerana masalah tayar. Alonso memulakan perlumbaan di tempat ketiga tetapi menamatkan perlumbaan di tempat kelapan selepas dua pit stop untuk membaiki sayap belakangnya yang rosak. "Jarang sekali melihat begitu banyak masalah dalam satu perlumbaan," komen Domenicali. "Kegagalan DRS telah menghalang Fernando, yang sekali lagi menunjukkan prestasi yang cemerlang, daripada bersaing dengan Vettel untuk kemenangan." "Bagi Felipe, dua masalah tayar telah menghalangnya daripada mencapai kedudukan lima teratas. Beliau mampu melakukan ini." "Dalam empat perlumbaan pertama ini, kita belum memperoleh mata yang sepatutnya kita peroleh, disebabkan pelbagai faktor. Ini menjelaskan jurang yang besar dalam kedudukan." Persembahan yang kukuh di Australia dan China, di mana Alonso memperoleh kemenangan Ferrari yang dominan, memberi pasukan harapan. Mereka percaya mereka masih boleh mencabar Red Bull, Lotus, dan Mercedes untuk gelaran apabila perlumbaan disambung semula di Barcelona pada 12 Mei. "Kami yakin dengan keupayaan kami untuk bersaing untuk gelaran sehingga akhir. Tahun ini, kami telah berada dalam pertarungan sejak awal, yang merupakan perubahan," kata Domenicali. "Kita tidak sepatutnya berkecil hati. Sejarah menunjukkan kepada kita betapa cepatnya nasib boleh berubah, baik untuk kita mahupun terhadap kita."

article_content: In Iran, a 21-year-old law student named Zahra Shams from Ferdowsi University in Mashhad was detained on May 6, 2010, and placed in solitary confinement.  Shams, who is not involved in politics, was arrested because her sister, Fatemeh Shams, a poet, blogger, and Oxford University graduate student, actively supports the Green Movement in Iran. Fatemeh Shams became more outspoken after the previous summer's presidential election. Around that time, her husband, Mohammad Reza Jalaipour, also an Oxford graduate student, was arrested at the airport as they were leaving Iran to return to their studies in the UK.  He was imprisoned for over two months before being released, but is still prohibited from leaving Iran to rejoin his wife in Oxford and continue his education. Iranian authorities apparently arrested Zahra Shams to pressure Fatemeh into silence while she was in Oxford. However, Fatemeh remained vocal. Last week, Zahra Shams was released by the authorities. Another example is Majid Tavakoli, a 24-year-old student activist from Amir Kabir Technical University in Tehran. He has been jailed repeatedly for extended periods. Tavakoli was arrested on December 7, 2009, during student demonstrations protesting the contested 2009 presidential election. He became a global symbol of solidarity when Iranian authorities attempted to shame him by photographing him in women's veils, which are mandatory for women.  Almost immediately, numerous Iranian men posted pictures of themselves wearing veils online in support of Tavakoli. Similarly, when Tavakoli began a dry hunger strike to protest his solitary confinement, his mother also started a hunger strike in solidarity with her son, inspiring many young Iranians worldwide to follow suit.  The authorities responded by moving Tavakoli from solitary confinement to a general prison ward. Zahra Shams, an apolitical law student, and Majid Tavakoli, a prominent political activist viewed as troublesome by Iran's Islamic theocracy, illustrate the diverse ways young Iranians are challenging the 31-year rule of the theocratic government.  These young people, who comprise about 70% of Iran's population, have their hopes and ambitions labeled as a "menace" by the Islamic Republic's propaganda system.  Fortunately, this outdated propaganda is losing its effectiveness. Zahra Shams, Majid Tavakoli, and their generation are taking control of their own representation and communicating their desires to the world. June 12, 2010, marked the first anniversary of the election that initiated the Green Movement in Iran, a peaceful movement for civil rights that surprised the world.  In a region plagued by violence, the significance of a large-scale civil rights movement focused on the fundamental democratic question, "Where is my vote?", cannot be overstated.  This question had never been raised so broadly in any other aspiring democracy in the region.  Through this simple yet powerful question, millions of Iranians have challenged the Islamic Republic, exposing its harsh actions.  For those willing to pay attention, the Iranian cry for freedom echoes the ancient Greek concept of democracy, the French Revolution's ideals of liberty, equality, and fraternity, the American Revolution against tyranny, and the American Civil Rights Movement of the 1950s and 1960s. For questioning the official election results last year, innocent citizens have faced systematic and unrestrained violence from the security forces of a theocratic regime that seems acutely aware of its own lack of legitimacy.  Mir Hossein Mousavi and Mehdi Karroubi, two leading opposition figures, recently cancelled a planned mass silent rally on the Green Movement's anniversary due to fears of state-sponsored violence against peaceful protesters.  The Islamic Republic is, unfortunately, not unique in its use of state violence against civilians in the region.  Against this backdrop, the Green Movement in Iran has started a new and unprecedented chapter in the political culture of what was once termed "the Middle East" by colonial powers.  Violent coups, rebellions, military invasions, and uprisings are common in this region's political history.  In a region where the establishment of democratic institutions and peaceful transitions to democracy have been consistently hindered by the rise of authoritarian leaders from Gamal Abdel Nasser to Ayatollah Khomeini, the Green Movement notably lacks such a leader. It is demonstrating a new approach to democracy, emphasizing gradual steps and careful coalition-building. In contrast, the West's moral claims are weakened by ongoing conflicts in Iraq and Afghanistan, effectively under US-led occupation, and Israel's disregard for the humanitarian crisis in Gaza.  The torture in Iranian prisons like Kahrizak and Evin over the past year pales in comparison to the actions of the United States in Abu Ghraib, Guantanamo Bay, and Bagram Airbase during its "war on terror" over the last decade.  The United States has often supported undemocratic regimes to protect its immediate interests, compromising its stated ideals and principles.  Today, Iranian demonstrators facing brutal repression are more faithful to the ideals of Thomas Jefferson and Martin Luther King Jr. than those in power in the United States. The possibility of an Islamic Republic acquiring nuclear weapons is a critical issue for the United States.  However, President Obama's credibility in preventing Iran's nuclear ambitions is questionable given the double standard of not holding Israel or Pakistan, nuclear-armed US allies not party to the nonproliferation treaty, accountable.  The Green Movement presents President Obama with a crucial opportunity to show courage and advocate for regional and global disarmament, based on nonviolent principles that Iranian community organizers seem to have learned from Martin Luther King Jr. more effectively than he has. One year later, the Green Movement continues to evolve in various forms, and it is unstoppable.  It may progress dramatically or gradually, but like a persistent river, it will continue until it reaches its goal.  From the quiet resilience of Zahra Shams in a Mashhad prison to the righteous anger of Majid Tavakoli awaiting his people's freedom in an Evin prison cell, young Iranians are teaching the world fundamental lessons about liberation, lessons that world leaders have yet to fully grasp. This commentary represents the personal opinions of Hamid Dabashi.
translated_content: Di Iran, seorang pelajar undang-undang berusia 21 tahun bernama Zahra Shams dari Universiti Ferdowsi di Mashhad telah ditahan pada 6 Mei 2010, dan ditempatkan dalam kurungan bersendirian. Shams, yang tidak terlibat dalam politik, ditangkap kerana kakaknya, Fatemeh Shams, seorang penyair, blogger, dan pelajar siswazah Universiti Oxford, secara aktif menyokong Pergerakan Hijau di Iran. Fatemeh Shams menjadi lebih lantang selepas pilihan raya presiden musim panas sebelumnya. Sekitar waktu itu, suaminya, Mohammad Reza Jalaipour, juga seorang pelajar siswazah Oxford, telah ditangkap di lapangan terbang ketika mereka meninggalkan Iran untuk kembali ke pengajian mereka di UK. Dia dipenjarakan selama lebih dari dua bulan sebelum dibebaskan, tetapi masih dilarang meninggalkan Iran untuk menyertai semula isterinya di Oxford dan meneruskan pendidikannya. Pihak berkuasa Iran nampaknya menangkap Zahra Shams untuk menekan Fatemeh agar berdiam diri ketika dia berada di Oxford. Walau bagaimanapun, Fatemeh tetap lantang. Minggu lepas, Zahra Shams telah dibebaskan oleh pihak berkuasa. Contoh lain ialah Majid Tavakoli, seorang aktivis pelajar berusia 24 tahun dari Universiti Teknikal Amir Kabir di Tehran. Dia telah dipenjarakan berulang kali untuk tempoh yang lama. Tavakoli telah ditangkap pada 7 Disember 2009, semasa demonstrasi pelajar membantah pilihan raya presiden 2009 yang dipertikaikan. Dia menjadi simbol solidariti global apabila pihak berkuasa Iran cuba memalukannya dengan mengambil gambarnya memakai tudung wanita, yang wajib bagi wanita. Hampir serta-merta, ramai lelaki Iran menyiarkan gambar diri mereka memakai tudung dalam talian sebagai tanda sokongan kepada Tavakoli. Begitu juga, apabila Tavakoli memulakan mogok lapar kering sebagai membantah kurungan bersendiriannya, ibunya juga memulakan mogok lapar sebagai solidariti dengan anaknya, yang memberi inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda Iran di seluruh dunia untuk mengikutinya. Pihak berkuasa bertindak balas dengan memindahkan Tavakoli dari kurungan bersendirian ke wad penjara biasa. Zahra Shams, seorang pelajar undang-undang apolitik, dan Majid Tavakoli, seorang aktivis politik terkemuka yang dianggap menyusahkan oleh teokrasi Islam Iran, menggambarkan pelbagai cara anak muda Iran mencabar pemerintahan teokrasi selama 31 tahun. Anak muda ini, yang merangkumi kira-kira 70% daripada populasi Iran, mempunyai harapan dan cita-cita mereka yang dilabel sebagai "ancaman" oleh sistem propaganda Republik Islam. Mujurlah, propaganda lapuk ini semakin kehilangan keberkesanannya. Zahra Shams, Majid Tavakoli, dan generasi mereka mengambil alih perwakilan mereka sendiri dan menyampaikan keinginan mereka kepada dunia. 12 Jun 2010, menandakan ulang tahun pertama pilihan raya yang memulakan Pergerakan Hijau di Iran, pergerakan aman untuk hak sivil yang mengejutkan dunia. Di rantau yang dilanda keganasan, kepentingan pergerakan hak sivil berskala besar yang memfokuskan pada soalan asas demokrasi, "Di mana undi saya?", tidak boleh diperkecilkan. Soalan ini tidak pernah dibangkitkan secara meluas di mana-mana demokrasi bercita-cita tinggi lain di rantau ini. Melalui soalan yang mudah namun berkuasa ini, berjuta-juta rakyat Iran telah mencabar Republik Islam, mendedahkan tindakan kerasnya. Bagi mereka yang sanggup memberi perhatian, seruan kebebasan Iran menggemakan konsep demokrasi Yunani kuno, cita-cita Revolusi Perancis tentang kebebasan, kesaksamaan, dan persaudaraan, Revolusi Amerika menentang kezaliman, dan Pergerakan Hak Sivil Amerika pada tahun 1950-an dan 1960-an. Kerana mempersoalkan keputusan pilihan raya rasmi tahun lepas, rakyat yang tidak bersalah telah menghadapi keganasan sistematik dan tidak terkawal daripada pasukan keselamatan rejim teokrasi yang nampaknya sangat menyedari kekurangan legitimasi mereka sendiri. Mir Hossein Mousavi dan Mehdi Karroubi, dua tokoh pembangkang terkemuka, baru-baru ini membatalkan perhimpunan senyap besar-besaran yang dirancang pada ulang tahun Pergerakan Hijau kerana kebimbangan tentang keganasan tajaan negara terhadap penunjuk perasaan aman. Republik Islam, malangnya, bukanlah satu-satunya yang menggunakan keganasan negara terhadap orang awam di rantau ini. Dengan latar belakang ini, Pergerakan Hijau di Iran telah memulakan babak baharu dan belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya dalam budaya politik yang pernah digelar "Timur Tengah" oleh kuasa penjajah. Rampasan kuasa ganas, pemberontakan, pencerobohan ketenteraan, dan pemberontakan adalah perkara biasa dalam sejarah politik rantau ini. Di rantau di mana penubuhan institusi demokrasi dan peralihan aman kepada demokrasi sentiasa dihalang oleh kebangkitan pemimpin autoritarian dari Gamal Abdel Nasser hingga Ayatollah Khomeini, Pergerakan Hijau ketara kekurangan pemimpin sedemikian. Ia menunjukkan pendekatan baharu terhadap demokrasi, menekankan langkah beransur-ansur dan pembinaan pakatan yang berhati-hati. Sebaliknya, dakwaan moral Barat dilemahkan oleh konflik berterusan di Iraq dan Afghanistan, yang secara efektif berada di bawah pendudukan pimpinan AS, dan ketidakpedulian Israel terhadap krisis kemanusiaan di Gaza. Penyiksaan di penjara Iran seperti Kahrizak dan Evin sejak setahun lalu tidak seberapa berbanding dengan tindakan Amerika Syarikat di Abu Ghraib, Guantanamo Bay, dan Pangkalan Udara Bagram semasa "perang melawan keganasan" selama sedekad yang lalu. Amerika Syarikat sering menyokong rejim tidak demokratik untuk melindungi kepentingan segera mereka, menjejaskan cita-cita dan prinsip yang dinyatakan mereka. Hari ini, penunjuk perasaan Iran yang menghadapi penindasan kejam lebih setia kepada cita-cita Thomas Jefferson dan Martin Luther King Jr. daripada mereka yang berkuasa di Amerika Syarikat. Kemungkinan Republik Islam memperoleh senjata nuklear adalah isu kritikal bagi Amerika Syarikat. Walau bagaimanapun, kredibiliti Presiden Obama dalam menghalang cita-cita nuklear Iran boleh dipersoalkan memandangkan standard berganda untuk tidak meminta Israel atau Pakistan, sekutu AS bersenjata nuklear yang bukan pihak dalam perjanjian bukan percambahan senjata nuklear, bertanggungjawab. Pergerakan Hijau memberikan Presiden Obama peluang penting untuk menunjukkan keberanian dan menyokong pelucutan senjata serantau dan global, berdasarkan prinsip tanpa kekerasan yang penganjur komuniti Iran nampaknya telah pelajari daripada Martin Luther King Jr. dengan lebih berkesan daripada dirinya. Setahun kemudian, Pergerakan Hijau terus berkembang dalam pelbagai bentuk, dan ia tidak dapat dihentikan. Ia mungkin berkembang secara dramatik atau beransur-ansur, tetapi seperti sungai yang berterusan, ia akan berterusan sehingga mencapai matlamatnya. Daripada ketahanan senyap Zahra Shams di penjara Mashhad hingga kemarahan yang benar Majid Tavakoli menunggu kebebasan rakyatnya di sel penjara Evin, anak muda Iran mengajar dunia pelajaran asas tentang pembebasan, pelajaran yang pemimpin dunia belum sepenuhnya fahami. Ulasan ini mewakili pendapat peribadi Hamid Dabashi.

article_content: Shot schoolgirl Malala Yousafzai's blood-spattered school uniform is displayed for the first time as a stark statement against extremists worldwide. The glass case exhibition is at the Nobel Peace Centre in Oslo, Norway, where Malala will accept the Nobel Peace Prize. On display are the blue tunic, white headscarf, and white trousers, stained brown with dried blood, which the then 15-year-old wore when she was shot by the Taliban on her school bus in Pakistan. Grim memento: Malala Yousafzai's blood-stained clothes from the Taliban attack two years prior are exhibited in a glass case at the Nobel Peace Centre in Norway. Proud: Malala (now 17) specifically requested her bloodstained uniform be included in the exhibition. Now 17, Malala is to receive the Nobel Peace Prize jointly with Kailash Satyarthi, 60, an Indian campaigner who has fought for 35 years to liberate children from forced labour. This pairing has sparked hopes of improved relations between India and Pakistan, nations with a history of conflict. Malala has dominated headlines due to her global recognition and youth, becoming the youngest Nobel Laureate. Already known as an activist and recipient of Pakistan's National Youth Peace Prize, she was on a school bus in October 2012 when it was stopped by a masked Taliban gunman. The gunman asked for her by name and fired multiple shots at Malala and her friends, injuring two others. Difference: At just 15, an injured Malala was transported to an Army hospital for treatment after the shooting. Museum piece: The uniform is the centrepiece of an exhibition about this year's Nobel laureates in Oslo. The bullet that struck Malala in the head passed through her neck and lodged in the muscle above her shoulder blade. Following the shooting, she was moved to Birmingham for extensive surgery and to begin a new life, continuing her advocacy for girls' education. The exhibition will run for approximately two months, after which the uniform will be returned to Malala's family. 'My school uniform is very important to me,' Malala stated. 'I was wearing this uniform on the day of the attack. I was fighting for my right to attend school.' 'Wearing a uniform affirmed my identity as a student. It's a significant part of my life.' 'Now, I want to show it to children and people worldwide. Education is my right, and the right of every child.' Celebration: Malala arrived today and met Torbjorn Jagland, chairman of the Nobel Committee. Joint prize: Malala shares the prize with Kailash Satyarthi, 60, who has dedicated 35 years to freeing children from forced labour. He is from India, a country with strained relations with Pakistan. Bente Erichsen, executive director of the Nobel Peace Centre, added: 'Malala’s blood-stained uniform is a powerful and poignant symbol of the struggles many girls face for their right to education.' 'The family has preserved the uniform since the attempted murder in October 2012, and we appreciate Malala's decision to display it in our exhibition.' Malala was honoured by the Nobel committee for her 'struggle against the suppression of children and young people and for the right of all children to education'. She invited her two friends who were injured in the same attack to Oslo to witness the Peace Prize ceremony. Shazia Ramazan, now 16, and Kainat Riaz, now 17, embraced their friend and posed for photos with her today. The trio told reporters they are united in 'Mission Malala' - collaborating with people globally to ensure girls have access to education. Special guests: Malala (fourth left) invited fellow campaigners (from left) Amina Yusuf from Nigeria, Kainat Soomro from Pakistan, school friend Shazia Ramzan, Mezon Almellehan from Syria and school friend Kainat Riaz. 'With education, you can achieve anything,' Riaz said. 'Without education, you are limited.' Both girls remained in Pakistan after the attack and continued their schooling under police protection. They are now studying at UWC Atlantic College near Cardiff, south Wales, and aspire to become doctors. 'The Malala mission is our mission. She’s my friend,' Riaz stated. 'And she inspired us. Inshallah, we will always support her.' Malala added: 'Although I am receiving this award as an individual, I know I am not alone. 'These brave girls are not just my friends; they are now my sisters in our campaign for education for every child.'
translated_content: Pakaian seragam sekolah Malala Yousafzai yang ditembak, yang berlumuran darah, dipamerkan buat kali pertama sebagai kenyataan tegas menentang ekstremis di seluruh dunia. Pameran bekas kaca itu berada di Pusat Keamanan Nobel di Oslo, Norway, tempat Malala akan menerima Hadiah Keamanan Nobel. Yang dipamerkan ialah tunik biru, tudung kepala putih, dan seluar putih, yang diwarnai coklat dengan darah kering, yang dipakai oleh remaja berusia 15 tahun itu ketika dia ditembak oleh Taliban di dalam bas sekolahnya di Pakistan. Peringatan suram: Pakaian Malala Yousafzai yang berlumuran darah dari serangan Taliban dua tahun sebelumnya dipamerkan dalam bekas kaca di Pusat Keamanan Nobel di Norway. Bangga: Malala (kini 17 tahun) secara khusus meminta pakaian seragamnya yang berlumuran darah dimasukkan ke dalam pameran. Kini berusia 17 tahun, Malala akan menerima Hadiah Keamanan Nobel bersama Kailash Satyarthi, 60, seorang aktivis India yang telah berjuang selama 35 tahun untuk membebaskan kanak-kanak daripada buruh paksa. Gandingan ini telah mencetuskan harapan untuk hubungan yang lebih baik antara India dan Pakistan, negara-negara yang mempunyai sejarah konflik. Malala telah menguasai tajuk utama kerana pengiktirafan global dan usia mudanya, menjadi Penerima Nobel termuda. Sudah dikenali sebagai seorang aktivis dan penerima Hadiah Keamanan Belia Kebangsaan Pakistan, dia berada di dalam bas sekolah pada Oktober 2012 ketika ia dihentikan oleh seorang lelaki bersenjata Taliban bertopeng. Lelaki bersenjata itu meminta namanya dan melepaskan beberapa das tembakan ke arah Malala dan rakan-rakannya, mencederakan dua yang lain. Perbezaan: Pada usia 15 tahun, Malala yang cedera telah dibawa ke hospital Tentera untuk rawatan selepas kejadian tembakan. Barang muzium: Pakaian seragam itu adalah tumpuan utama pameran mengenai penerima Hadiah Nobel tahun ini di Oslo. Peluru yang mengenai kepala Malala menembusi lehernya dan tersangkut di otot di atas tulang belikatnya. Selepas kejadian tembakan itu, dia dipindahkan ke Birmingham untuk pembedahan yang meluas dan untuk memulakan kehidupan baharu, meneruskan advokasinya untuk pendidikan kanak-kanak perempuan. Pameran ini akan berlangsung selama kira-kira dua bulan, selepas itu pakaian seragam itu akan dikembalikan kepada keluarga Malala. 'Pakaian seragam sekolah saya sangat penting bagi saya,' kata Malala. 'Saya memakai pakaian seragam ini pada hari serangan itu. Saya berjuang untuk hak saya untuk bersekolah.' 'Memakai pakaian seragam mengesahkan identiti saya sebagai seorang pelajar. Ia adalah bahagian penting dalam hidup saya.' 'Sekarang, saya mahu menunjukkannya kepada kanak-kanak dan orang ramai di seluruh dunia. Pendidikan adalah hak saya, dan hak setiap kanak-kanak.' Perayaan: Malala tiba hari ini dan bertemu dengan Torbjorn Jagland, pengerusi Jawatankuasa Nobel. Hadiah bersama: Malala berkongsi hadiah itu dengan Kailash Satyarthi, 60, yang telah mendedikasikan 35 tahun untuk membebaskan kanak-kanak daripada buruh paksa. Dia berasal dari India, sebuah negara yang mempunyai hubungan tegang dengan Pakistan. Bente Erichsen, pengarah eksekutif Pusat Keamanan Nobel, menambah: 'Pakaian seragam Malala yang berlumuran darah adalah simbol yang kuat dan pedih tentang perjuangan yang dihadapi ramai gadis untuk hak mereka untuk mendapatkan pendidikan.' 'Keluarga itu telah menyimpan pakaian seragam itu sejak percubaan pembunuhan pada Oktober 2012, dan kami menghargai keputusan Malala untuk mempamerkannya dalam pameran kami.' Malala telah dihormati oleh jawatankuasa Nobel atas 'perjuangannya menentang penindasan kanak-kanak dan orang muda dan untuk hak semua kanak-kanak untuk pendidikan'. Dia menjemput dua rakannya yang cedera dalam serangan yang sama ke Oslo untuk menyaksikan upacara Hadiah Keamanan. Shazia Ramazan, kini 16, dan Kainat Riaz, kini 17, memeluk rakan mereka dan bergambar dengan beliau hari ini. Trio itu memberitahu wartawan bahawa mereka bersatu dalam 'Misi Malala' - bekerjasama dengan orang ramai di seluruh dunia untuk memastikan kanak-kanak perempuan mendapat akses kepada pendidikan. Tetamu istimewa: Malala (keempat dari kiri) menjemput rakan-rakan aktivis (dari kiri) Amina Yusuf dari Nigeria, Kainat Soomro dari Pakistan, rakan sekolah Shazia Ramzan, Mezon Almellehan dari Syria dan rakan sekolah Kainat Riaz. 'Dengan pendidikan, anda boleh mencapai apa sahaja,' kata Riaz. 'Tanpa pendidikan, anda terhad.' Kedua-dua gadis itu kekal di Pakistan selepas serangan itu dan meneruskan persekolahan mereka di bawah perlindungan polis. Mereka kini belajar di Kolej UWC Atlantic berhampiran Cardiff, Wales Selatan, dan bercita-cita untuk menjadi doktor. 'Misi Malala adalah misi kami. Dia kawan saya,' kata Riaz. 'Dan dia memberi inspirasi kepada kami. Insya-Allah, kami akan sentiasa menyokongnya.' Malala menambah: 'Walaupun saya menerima anugerah ini sebagai individu, saya tahu saya tidak bersendirian. 'Gadis-gadis berani ini bukan sahaja rakan saya; mereka kini saudara perempuan saya dalam kempen kami untuk pendidikan untuk setiap kanak-kanak.'

article_content: With his long floppy ears and apparently docile demeanour, Toby the rabbit is hardly as threatening as a guard dog, but for one family, he has certainly proved just as effective. Kimberley May recounted yesterday how her huge pet rabbit scared off a burglar by thumping his massive feet on the floor. Protector: Kimberley May and her three-year-old daughter Olivia with giant bunny Toby after he scared off a burglar by thumping loudly. She and her fiance Martin had only had two-year-old Toby for a couple of weeks when an intruder broke into their home in Plymouth. But his owners believe the raider was scared off thanks to the British Giant rabbit stomping his feet in his cage. Miss May, a hospital staff nurse, said she was half woken in the early hours by Toby making ‘five loud thumps’ but she went back to sleep. In the morning, Martin went downstairs and found a First World War medal, a laptop and iPad missing, but a lot of other valuables had been left behind. Miss May said: ‘We went to bed on Wednesday at about 10pm. In the early hours of the morning Toby our rabbit did five loud thumps. I sort of half woke up, then realised he’d stopped and went back to sleep. ‘When I went downstairs, every single cupboard and drawer was open, there were bits out everywhere. Then we started noticing that things were missing and we phoned the police. ‘They managed to take a laptop, an iPad and my handbag with my purse and everything in, but the worst thing was my great-granddad’s medal.’ Intruder: The thief broke into the family home in Plymouth without realising it was under the protection of a monster bunny. Raising the alarm: The 4.5kg, 2ft-long pet began stomping so loudly on the floor that the intruder fled. The medal was a King’s Liverpool Regiment medal belonging to Henry Godwin Porter. It is silver and inscribed with his name and regiment. Miss May added: ‘My gran died in 2007, she lived in a council house all her life and hardly had any possessions. That was the one important thing she had.’ Miss May said she found a hoard of items left piled up on the sofa which she thinks the burglar was preparing to take but left behind. ‘We think that when the rabbit thumped it scared off the burglars and they left all the stuff they were going to take,’ she added. The couple, who have a three-year-old daughter, Olivia, are due to get married in nearby Plympton on August 30. Miss May said: ‘They also took a box which had all our wedding invitations and favours in it as well as paperwork which I was due to give to the church and reception venue. Reward: Toby's delighted owner has bought him a new tunnel to play with as a thank you present. Hero: When Miss May came downstairs she found a hoard of items left piled up on the sofa which she thinks the burglar was preparing to take but left behind. ‘I’ve had to go to the library to get proof that I used to live in Plympton so I can get married at the church – they just don’t think about the impact it has to take things like that.’ After the break-in, Toby was left ‘traumatised’ and even tried to attack the policeman who came to investigate. The 4.5kg rabbit is nearly 2ft long and 10in tall, and he could yet grow more – British Giant rabbits can reach up to 5.9kg. Toby is so big he lives in a cage built for a labrador. The family got their prized pet from an animal adoption centre which had taken him in. Miss May said: ‘He’s playful, really friendly, and he doesn’t mind my three-year-old crawling all over him. He’s like a small dog really. ‘When he thumps on the floor it’s incredibly loud – you can hear it echoing around the house.’ Police are appealing for information about the break-in, which happened a week ago. PC David Walters said: ‘They had the rabbit in the kitchen and mentioned that he was making a noise in the night. But there was nothing to say the burglar was definitely scared off.’
translated_content: Dengan telinga panjang yang terkulai dan tingkah laku yang kelihatan jinak, Toby si arnab mungkin tidak mengancam seperti anjing pengawal, tetapi bagi sebuah keluarga, dia ternyata sama efektifnya. Kimberley May menceritakan semalam bagaimana arnab peliharaannya yang besar telah menakutkan seorang pencuri dengan menghentakkan kaki besarnya di lantai. Pelindung: Kimberley May dan anak perempuannya Olivia yang berusia tiga tahun bersama arnab gergasi Toby selepas dia berjaya menakutkan seorang pencuri dengan hentakan yang kuat. Dia dan tunangnya Martin baru sahaja memiliki Toby yang berusia dua tahun selama beberapa minggu apabila seorang penceroboh memecah masuk ke rumah mereka di Plymouth. Namun, pemiliknya percaya penceroboh itu telah dihalau berkat arnab Gergasi British itu menghentakkan kakinya di dalam sangkar. Cik May, seorang jururawat hospital, berkata dia separuh terjaga pada awal pagi apabila Toby membuat ‘lima hentakan kuat’ tetapi dia kemudiannya tidur semula. Pada pagi itu, Martin turun ke tingkat bawah dan mendapati pingat Perang Dunia Pertama, sebuah komputer riba dan iPad hilang, tetapi banyak barang berharga lain yang ditinggalkan. Cik May berkata: ‘Kami tidur pada hari Rabu sekitar pukul 10 malam. Pada awal pagi, Toby arnab kami telah membuat lima hentakan kuat. Saya macam separuh terjaga, kemudian menyedari dia sudah berhenti dan saya tidur semula. ‘Apabila saya turun ke tingkat bawah, setiap almari dan laci terbuka, dengan barang-barang bersepah di merata-rata tempat. Kemudian kami mula menyedari bahawa ada barang yang hilang dan kami terus menghubungi pihak polis. ‘Mereka berjaya mengambil sebuah komputer riba, sebuah iPad dan beg tangan saya bersama dompet dan semua isinya, tetapi yang paling menyedihkan ialah kehilangan pingat datuk saya.’ Penceroboh: Pencuri itu memecah masuk ke rumah keluarga di Plymouth tanpa menyedari bahawa ia dilindungi oleh arnab gergasi. Membunyikan penggera: Haiwan peliharaan seberat 4.5kg dan sepanjang 2 kaki ini mula menghentak dengan kuat di lantai sehingga menyebabkan penceroboh itu melarikan diri. Pingat tersebut adalah pingat Rejimen Liverpool Raja yang dimiliki oleh Henry Godwin Porter. Ia berwarna perak dan terukir nama serta rejimennya. Cik May menambah: ‘Nenek saya meninggal dunia pada tahun 2007, dia tinggal di rumah pangsa sepanjang hayatnya dan hampir tidak memiliki apa-apa harta benda. Pingat itulah satu-satunya benda penting yang dimilikinya.’ Cik May berkata dia menjumpai timbunan barang yang ditinggalkan di atas sofa yang dipercayainya telah dikumpulkan oleh pencuri itu untuk dibawa tetapi kemudian ditinggalkan. ‘Kami percaya bahawa apabila arnab itu menghentak, ia telah menakutkan pencuri tersebut dan mereka meninggalkan semua barang yang mereka rancang untuk ambil,’ tambahnya. Pasangan itu, yang mempunyai seorang anak perempuan berusia tiga tahun, Olivia, akan melangsungkan perkahwinan di Plympton yang berdekatan pada 30 Ogos. Cik May berkata: ‘Mereka juga mengambil sebuah kotak yang mengandungi semua kad jemputan dan cenderamata perkahwinan kami serta dokumen-dokumen yang sepatutnya saya serahkan kepada pihak gereja dan tempat resepsi. Ganjaran: Pemilik Toby yang gembira telah membelikannya sebuah terowong baru sebagai hadiah penghargaan. Wira: Apabila Cik May turun ke tingkat bawah, dia menjumpai timbunan barang yang ditinggalkan di atas sofa yang dipercayainya telah dikumpulkan oleh pencuri itu untuk dibawa tetapi kemudian ditinggalkan. ‘Saya terpaksa pergi ke perpustakaan untuk mendapatkan bukti bahawa saya pernah tinggal di Plympton supaya saya boleh berkahwin di gereja – mereka langsung tidak memikirkan kesan tindakan mereka mengambil barang-barang seperti itu.’ Selepas kejadian pecah rumah itu, Toby menjadi ‘trauma’ dan malah cuba menyerang anggota polis yang datang untuk menyiasat. Arnab seberat 4.5kg ini hampir 2 kaki panjang dan 10 inci tinggi, dan dia mungkin akan terus membesar – arnab Gergasi British boleh mencapai berat sehingga 5.9kg. Toby sangat besar sehingga dia tinggal di dalam sangkar yang dibina untuk seekor labrador. Keluarga itu mendapatkan haiwan peliharaan kesayangan mereka dari sebuah pusat perlindungan haiwan yang telah menjaganya. Cik May berkata: ‘Dia suka bermain, sangat mesra, dan dia tidak kisah anak perempuan saya yang berusia tiga tahun memanjat dan bermain dengannya. Dia seperti seekor anjing kecil sebenarnya. ‘Apabila dia menghentak di lantai, bunyinya sangat kuat – anda boleh mendengarnya bergema di seluruh rumah.’ Pihak polis sedang meminta maklumat mengenai kejadian pecah rumah itu, yang berlaku seminggu yang lalu. PC David Walters berkata: ‘Mereka memelihara arnab itu di dapur dan ada menyebut bahawa ia telah membuat bising pada waktu malam. Namun, tiada bukti yang menunjukkan bahawa pencuri itu sememangnya telah dihalau oleh arnab tersebut.’

article_content: BENGALURU: HD Kumaraswamy, the state president of JD(S), continued his criticism of Chief Minister Siddaramaiah on Sunday, asserting that Siddaramaiah has "outsourced" the administration of his Varuna constituency to his son, Yathindra. The former JD(S) Chief Minister also claimed that Yathindra has transformed the chief minister’s position into that of "a telephone operator," allegedly using it for a "cash for posting" scheme. Siddaramaiah dismissed these comments, stating that he does not need to respond to "false allegations." In a series of posts on X, Kumaraswamy again referred to Yathindra as the "corrupt son of Siddaramaiah" and questioned the relevance of R Mahadevu, whose name Yathindra supposedly mentioned in a phone conversation with his father, to the Varuna constituency. He included a list of officials stationed at the chief minister’s secretariat in his post. "It is a fact that your son, Yathindra, spoke to you about the transfer scam," Kumaraswamy stated. "While Mahadevu has no apparent connection to the Varuna assembly segment, the education department, or the chief secretary, why did your son bring up his name concerning the posting of education department officials?" He used the hashtag #Cash-forposting and clarified that ‘CSR’ in this context stands for ‘Corrupt Son of Siddaramaiah’. "You are deflecting from the issue of the video clip of your son’s phone conversation. You are accountable to the people of Karnataka. Your entire cabinet is losing sleep over this video clip and acting like your bodyguards. You are mistaken if you believe I am afraid of them and will run away," Kumaraswamy added in another post. Kumaraswamy pointed out that while Siddaramaiah appointed Yathindra as chairman of the Ashraya committee, he himself never "outsourced" his constituency to his son, Nikhil Kumaraswamy, when he was chief minister. "To my knowledge, no other chief minister has outsourced their constituency to their son. You have appointed your son to the KDP merely to grant him power through the backdoor," Kumaraswamy remarked. In his response, Siddaramaiah reiterated his pledge to retire from politics if the ‘cash-for-post’ accusations are substantiated. "There is no need for me to respond to him even if Kumaraswamy tweets a hundred times. He is now discussing transfers and alleged cash involvement that supposedly occurred during his tenure. I have stated that I would retire from politics if his allegations against me are proven, and I stand by that," Siddaramaiah concluded.
translated_content: BENGALURU: HD Kumaraswamy, presiden negeri JD(S), meneruskan kritiknya terhadap Ketua Menteri Siddaramaiah pada hari Ahad, menegaskan bahawa Siddaramaiah telah "menyerahkan" pentadbiran kawasan Varuna kepada anaknya, Yathindra. Bekas Ketua Menteri JD(S) itu juga mendakwa bahawa Yathindra telah mengubah jawatan ketua menteri menjadi seperti "operator telefon," yang didakwa menggunakannya untuk skim "wang tunai untuk pengeposan". Siddaramaiah menolak komen-komen ini, menyatakan bahawa beliau tidak perlu menjawab "dakwaan palsu." Dalam beberapa siri hantaran di X, Kumaraswamy sekali lagi merujuk Yathindra sebagai "anak Siddaramaiah yang korup" dan mempersoalkan kaitan R Mahadevu, yang namanya kononnya disebut oleh Yathindra dalam perbualan telefon dengan bapanya, dengan kawasan Varuna. Beliau menyertakan senarai pegawai yang ditempatkan di sekretariat ketua menteri dalam hantarannya. "Adalah fakta bahawa anak anda, Yathindra, bercakap dengan anda tentang penipuan pemindahan," kata Kumaraswamy. "Walaupun Mahadevu tidak mempunyai kaitan yang jelas dengan kawasan DUN Varuna, jabatan pendidikan, atau ketua setiausaha, mengapa anak anda menyebut namanya berkaitan dengan penempatan pegawai jabatan pendidikan?" Beliau menggunakan tanda pagar #Cash-forposting dan menjelaskan bahawa ‘CSR’ dalam konteks ini bermaksud ‘Anak Siddaramaiah yang Korup’. "Anda mengalih perhatian daripada isu klip video perbualan telefon anak anda. Anda bertanggungjawab kepada rakyat Karnataka. Seluruh kabinet anda tidak dapat tidur lena kerana klip video ini dan bertindak seperti pengawal peribadi anda. Anda silap jika anda percaya saya takut kepada mereka dan akan melarikan diri," tambah Kumaraswamy dalam hantaran lain. Kumaraswamy menegaskan bahawa walaupun Siddaramaiah melantik Yathindra sebagai pengerusi jawatankuasa Ashraya, beliau sendiri tidak pernah "menyerahkan" kawasan DUN beliau kepada anaknya, Nikhil Kumaraswamy, ketika beliau menjadi ketua menteri. "Setahu saya, tiada ketua menteri lain yang telah menyerahkan kawasan DUN mereka kepada anak mereka. Anda telah melantik anak anda ke KDP hanya untuk memberinya kuasa melalui pintu belakang," kata Kumaraswamy. Dalam responsnya, Siddaramaiah mengulangi ikrarnya untuk bersara daripada politik jika dakwaan ‘wang tunai untuk jawatan’ itu berasas. "Saya tidak perlu menjawab kepadanya walaupun Kumaraswamy membuat tweet seratus kali. Beliau kini membincangkan pemindahan dan dakwaan penglibatan wang tunai yang kononnya berlaku semasa pemerintahannya. Saya telah menyatakan bahawa saya akan bersara daripada politik jika dakwaan beliau terhadap saya terbukti, dan saya tetap dengan pendirian itu," Siddaramaiah menyimpulkan.

article_content: Football star Thierry Henry's ambitious plan to construct a 40ft aquarium in his North London home has sparked controversy with his neighbor, actor Tom Conti. Henry intends to demolish his £6 million house and build a taller residence to accommodate the massive four-storey aquarium, which would extend from the basement to the master bedroom. Conti and several other neighbors have voiced strong objections to the proposed construction, primarily due to concerns about the extensive disruption and noise it would cause. Conti questioned why Henry couldn't simply move to a larger house elsewhere rather than undertake such a significant demolition and rebuilding project. The proposed aquarium, estimated to cost £250,000, would hold 5,500 gallons of water and house 300 fish. Planning officials are considering Henry's application, which has also drawn opposition from the original architect of Henry's current home, Sir Richard MacCormac. Conti expressed concerns about months of drilling and construction noise, impacting residents who work from home or are retired. He emphasized the increasing construction in the area over the past decade and urged Henry to reconsider building the large aquarium next to his property. Henry argues his current home, built in 1999, is outdated and unsuitable for his needs, citing cramped spaces and poor daylight. However, Sir Richard MacCormac maintains that the house is structurally sound and has good daylighting, suggesting maintenance is the real issue. Neighbors also raised concerns about privacy due to the proposed taller building with more windows facing their properties. The Heath and Hampstead Society has also opposed the plan, criticizing the new house design as lacking style and elegance. Henry's aquarium would rival those of other celebrities like Madonna and the Beckhams, highlighting a trend of opulent displays among the rich and famous. Despite the controversy, Henry reportedly wishes to maintain a London base to be near his daughter.

article_content: FIFA has announced that all 800 player samples collected during the World Cup doping program have tested negative so far. The governing body of world football also stated that players tested after the initial nine matches also returned negative results. These tests include samples from 91 percent of players selected in the 30-man preliminary squads for the 32 participating teams. Jiri Dvorak, FIFA's chief medical officer, confirmed the smooth operation of the process, including sample transport from locations like Manaus to the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) laboratory in Switzerland. He stated, '(It) all worked well, including the transport from Manaus.' Despite logistical challenges, such as transporting samples from remote areas like Manaus, where Italy played England (2-1), samples were provided and transported without delay. Dvorak added, 'All samples arrived (in) under 36 hours to Lausanne and were processed within 24 hours.' In contrast to previous issues with the Rio de Janeiro laboratory, which had its accreditation revoked by WADA last year for non-compliance, there have been no such problems during this World Cup.
